title: AI Proposal & Property Design Specialist (Luxury Airbnb)
description:
We’re a growing luxury Airbnb property management company looking for someone highly skilled with AI tools to create customized proposals for prospective property owners.



We already have templates and systems in place. We need someone who can work quickly, produce high-quality results, and has a strong eye for design.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Use Claude AI and our existing templates to create customized property proposals.

• Use ChatGPT image generation to refresh property photos in our design style.

• Research competing Airbnb listings, revenue comps, and market potential.

• Deliver proposals quickly, as clients often book calls the same day or next day.

• Create AI-generated interior redesign concepts for properties we sign.

• Source high-quality furniture and decor from Amazon and Wayfair and build shopping carts for property owners.



REQUIREMENTS



• Must be highly proficient with Claude AI and ChatGPT.

• Must have strong knowledge of Airbnb.

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to work quickly.

• Strong English communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and follow established systems.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



• Short-term rental or Airbnb management experience.

• AirDNA experience is a MAJOR plus.

• Interior design, graphic design, or virtual staging experience.

• Furniture sourcing experience.



HOW TO APPLY



IMPORTANT: Put your FAVORITE COLOR in the subject line of your application. Applications without this will not be considered.



Favorite color - Proposal Applicant



Please include:

1. Your experience with Claude, ChatGPT, and Airbnb.

2. Whether you have experience using AirDNA.

3. Examples of AI-generated images, proposals, or interior design work.

4. Your availability



We will likely start part time then transition into full time as we see fit. We are flexible depending on skillset.



SKILLS TEST



Shortlisted applicants will receive photographs of an actual property and be asked to refresh the rooms using AI to match our luxury design style. This will help us evaluate your creativity, attention to detail, and AI image generation skills.



We're looking for someone reliable, fast, creative, and detail-oriented who can grow with our company.

title: B2B Sales Development Representative (Remote – Promotional Products)
description:
About Brand Bros



Brand Bros is growing its promotional products division, offering businesses custom-branded merchandise, apparel, corporate gifts, and promotional products.

We're looking for a proactive and confident B2B Sales Development Representative to help us find new customers, connect with business owners, and generate qualified sales opportunities.

If you're comfortable with cold outreach, enjoy starting conversations, and know how to build a strong prospect pipeline, we'd love to hear from you!

Your main goal is to generate interest and qualified leads. Once a prospect is ready to explore products and pricing, you'll hand them over to our account manager, who will handle the quotation and order process.



Key Responsibilities



Research potential business customers and identify key decision-makers.

Build targeted lists of businesses and qualified prospects.

Conduct cold calls, personalized
s, and social media outreach through LinkedIn,
, and Instagram.

Introduce our branded merchandise, promotional products, custom apparel, and corporate gifts.

Identify opportunities related to company events, employee programs, marketing campaigns, and client appreciation.

Follow up with prospects and nurture potential business relationships.

Qualify interested leads based on their needs, estimated quantities, budget, and purchasing timeline.

Schedule meetings and hand over qualified opportunities to the account manager.

Keep CRM records updated and provide regular progress reports.

Suggest new outreach strategies and ways to generate more business.



Qualifications & Requirements



Experience in B2B sales, cold calling, cold
ing, lead generation, or appointment setting.

Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Confidence communicating with business owners and decision-makers.

Good research, organization, and follow-up skills.

Ability to handle objections and initiate conversations with potential customers.

Familiarity with CRM systems and lead-tracking tools.

Ability to work independently and meet performance targets.

Reliable internet, headset, and quiet workspace.

Availability during agreed U.S. business hours.



Nice to Have:



Experience selling promotional products or branded merchandise.

Familiarity with GoHighLevel, CommonSku, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or
 outreach tools.

Performance Expectations

Your performance will be measured by:

Relevant prospects researched and contacted.

Meaningful conversations with decision-makers.

Qualified leads generated.

Meetings or sales calls scheduled.

Consistency of follow-ups.

Accuracy of CRM records.

New customers and sales generated through your outreach.

Specific targets will be discussed during onboarding.



Work Arrangement & Compensation



Work Setup: Fully Remote

Employment Type: To be discussed

Schedule: To be agreed upon (U.S. business hours)

Compensation: Negotiable, with applicable commission or performance incentives to be discussed.



How to Apply



Interested candidates should
 
 with the subject line:

Application – B2B Sales Development Representative – [Your Name]



Please include:

Resume: Highlight your relevant sales, prospecting, or lead-generation experience and results.

Outreach Experience: Tell us which channels and tools you've used (cold calling,
, LinkedIn, CRM, etc.).

Sample Outreach: Write a short example of how you would approach a business owner to introduce our promotional products.

Introduction Video: Send a 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you're a good fit.

Internet Speed Test: Attach a recent screenshot showing your download and upload speeds.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical assessment involving prospect research, outreach writing, lead qualification, or a mock cold call.



We're looking for someone who takes initiative, communicates confidently, and knows how to turn potential customers into real business opportunities. If that sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!

title: Video & Audio Ads Editor (Part-Time, 20 hrs/week) for Fast-Growing E-commerce Brand
description:
Type of work: Part-time

Wage: Open, tell us your monthly rate

Hours per week: 20, flexible schedule



About us



We make custom branded grip socks and studio essentials for 800+ pilates, yoga and barre studios in the US, UK, Europe and Australia. We’re a team of 16 and growing fast, and video ads on Meta and TikTok are a big part of how we grow.



The role



We’re looking for a skilled video editor who knows how to turn raw footage into ads that stop the scroll and sell. Great audio is just as important to us as great visuals: the right music and clean sound make or break an ad. You’ll work directly with Paul, our Creative Strategist, who provides the briefs, scripts and footage. You turn them into finished ads.



What you’ll do



- Edit 5 to 10 video ads per week for Meta 
/Instagram) and TikTok

- Cut UGC and talking-head footage into ads with strong hooks, good pacing and a clear call to action

- Create product videos showing our grip socks: close-ups, details and studio vibes

- Add motion graphics, animated text and captions that fit our brand style

- Select music that fits our brand: feminine, elegant, calm yet uplifting, matching the world of pilates, yoga and barre

- Edit and mix audio: clean up voice-overs and UGC audio, balance voice and music levels, add sound effects where they add value, and time cuts to the beat

- Make variations of ads (different hooks, lengths and formats: 9:16, 4:5, 1:1)

- Deliver on time and handle feedback quickly



Requirements



- At least 1 year of experience editing ads for e-commerce or DTC brands

- A portfolio with video ads you’ve made (Meta/TikTok ads preferred). Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

- Strong skills in Premiere Pro, After Effects and DaVinci Resolve

- Solid audio editing skills (noise reduction, mixing, levelling) and a good ear for music

- Experience choosing music for brands with a feminine audience; bonus if you’ve worked for fitness, wellness, beauty or fashion brands

- Knowledge of royalty-free and commercially licensed music libraries (e.g. Artlist, Epidemic Sound)

- A good eye for aesthetics, pacing and short-form trends

- Good written English

- Reliable internet and a computer that can handle 2K editing

- Self-managing: we work flexibly, so you need to plan your own time and meet deadlines



What we offer



- Long-term part-time position with a stable, growing company

- Flexible hours: work when it suits you, as long as deadlines are met

- A creative team that values quality and gives clear briefs

- Room to grow as our video output increases



How to apply



Send us:



- Your portfolio (links to video ads you’ve edited)

- A short intro about yourself and your editing experience

- One example of an ad where you chose the music, and a sentence on why that track fit the brand

- Your expected monthly rate for 20 hours/week

- Start your application with the word “GRIPSOCKS” so we know you’ve read the full post



Shortlisted candidates will get a paid test assignment: turning raw footage into a short ad***, including music selection and audio mix***.

title: Operations & Customer Relations Manager — US Construction Company
description:
About Us



We are a growing US-based residential construction and home services business specialising in remodelling, renovations, and home improvement projects.



We work with a network of contractors and pride ourselves on excellent customer service, strong communication, and efficient operations.



We are looking for a highly organised, proactive, and professional Operations & Customer Relations Manager to oversee our daily operations.



This is a long-term opportunity with significant career growth potential as we expand into additional US locations.



Key Responsibilities



1. Contractor Recruitment & Onboarding



Recruit, interview, and onboard approximately 3–4 construction contractors initially.



Assess contractor experience, reliability, and communication skills.



Coordinate required documentation and onboarding.



Maintain contractor relationships and assist with future recruitment.



Full training, interview recordings, scripts, and procedures will be provided.



2. Contractor Operations & Management



Communicate regularly with contractors via phone and SMS.



Monitor scheduled appointments and contractor calendars.



Ensure contractors attend appointments and provide timely updates.



Follow up with contractors to obtain estimates and project information.



Resolve scheduling and communication issues.



3. Customer Relations & Follow-Ups



Contact homeowners following appointments to check their experience.



Build rapport and maintain professional customer relationships.



Follow up with customers after proposals have been delivered.



Answer questions and coordinate information with contractors.



Ensure consistent communication throughout the customer's decision-making process.



This is not a cold-calling or high-pressure sales position. Our customers have already expressed interest in our services.



4. Proposals & CRM Management



Prepare customer proposals using our existing templates.



Coordinate project details and pricing with contractors.



Track appointments, proposals, and customer follow-ups.



Maintain accurate CRM records and provide operational updates.



Requirements



Essential:



Excellent spoken and written English.



Friendly, confident, and professional telephone manner.



Previous experience communicating with US customers.



Strong organisational and time-management skills.



Proactive, reliable, and capable of working independently.



Excellent attention to detail.



Comfortable using CRM systems and learning new software.



Preferred:



Operations management or coordination experience.



Contractor or vendor management experience.



Recruitment and interviewing experience.



Previous experience managing or training employees.



Construction, home services, or real estate experience.



Previous construction experience is not required.



Career Growth & Leadership Opportunities



We have ambitious plans to expand into additional US locations.



Initially, you will work directly with the business owner to learn and independently manage the operations of our first location.



As we expand, we plan to hire additional Operations Managers for new locations.



The right candidate will have the opportunity to help train and support future Operations Managers, with the potential to progress into a Head of Operations position.



This future leadership role would involve overseeing multiple locations, managing Operations Managers, monitoring performance, and helping the business expand.



Salary increases and career progression will be based on performance, responsibilities, and company growth.



We are looking for someone ambitious who wants to build a long-term career with us.



Working Hours & Compensation



Salary: $1,000–$1,200 USD/month.



Schedule: 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday.



Hours: US Central business hours. 8am-4pm Ideally.



Employment: Long-term, remote.



This is a dedicated full-time position. We are not looking for applicants intending to work multiple full-time jobs simultaneously.



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your Resume/CV



Highlight relevant operations, recruitment, and US customer service experience.



2. A 60–90 Second Voice Recording or Loom Video



Introduce yourself, describe your experience, and explain why you would be a good fit.



3. Answer These Questions:



What experience do you have communicating with US customers over the phone?



Have you previously managed appointments, customer follow-ups, or CRM systems?



A contractor has completed an appointment but hasn't provided their estimate. How would you handle this?



A homeowner has received a $25,000 proposal and is still considering their options. How would you follow up?



Have you previously managed or trained other employees?



Are you available to work full-time during US Central business hours without conflicting employment commitments?





Applications without a voice recording and answers to the questions will not be considered.



We're looking for a friendly, organised, dependable, and ambitious professional who wants to grow with our company.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Operations Coordinator (Fleet & Logistics)
description:
Operations Coordinator (Fleet & Logistics) – Remote, U.S. Eastern Hours



Beeline Group is a growing U.S. transportation company running FedEx linehaul and delivery routes from 11 terminals in Maryland, Virginia, D.C., Pennsylvania, and Georgia. We’re looking for an Operations Coordinator to keep our daily operations organized: drivers, trucks, schedules, and safety.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll work directly with the owner and our station managers, and you’ll be the person who knows where every truck and driver is supposed to be.

What you’ll do

Build and update the daily and weekend driver schedules.

Contact drivers to confirm availability and fill open shifts.

Assign trucks to drivers and runs, and make sure drivers are logged in to the correct truck and assignment each day.

Track which trucks are in the shop, which are due for maintenance, and which are available.

Check that all drivers complete their required monthly safety training.

Review safety and ELD alerts and follow up with station managers.

Keep schedules, truck lists, and records accurate and up to date in Excel and our fleet systems.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Are you passionate about building robust, scalable, and intelligent data pipelines? Do you want to work on modern infrastructure, solve complex data challenges, and help shape the future of analytics for Managed Service Providers? MSPbots is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help us scale our data infrastructure, streamline integrations, and empower insights across hundreds of clients.



Work Setup: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Monday–Friday from 9 PM to 6 AM PHT (8 AM–5 PM CDT) | Fixed Rest Days: Sat–Sun



What You’ll Do

1.Data Pipeline & Integration Engineering

-Build and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines for ingesting data from PSA, RMM, and monitoring tools

-Use tools like Airflow, dbt, and Fivetran to develop scalable workflows

-Implement normalization and integration logic across MSP platforms (ConnectWise, Kaseya, Datto, N-able)



2.Data Infrastructure & Platform Ownership

-Help scale and maintain cloud-based data infrastructure (Azure)

-Contribute to CI/CD for data workflows and align with DevOps best practices

-Improve performance through data partitioning, syncing, and storage tuning



3.Data Modeling & Consistency

-Create and maintain well-documented dimensional and normalized data models

-Align data schemas and transformations with product and business logic

-Power dashboards, bots, and analytics through reliable backend design



4.Data Quality, Governance & Compliance

-Implement Data Quality Indicators (DQIs) and monitor pipeline reliability

-Support access control, data auditing, and compliance with SOC 2, GDPR, and CCPA

-Ensure consistency and completeness across integrated systems



5.Documentation & Metadata Stewardship

-Maintain clear documentation of schemas, lineage, and transformation logic

-Help define metadata standards and contribute to the central data catalog



6.Cross-Team Collaboration

-Work closely with Data Analysts, Developers, and Customer Teams to translate business needs

-Enable the delivery of high-quality data for dashboards, reports, and automation bots

-Act as a subject matter expert on our data models and platform integrations



7. Enable a Data-Driven Culture

-Promote clean code, modular design, and performance best practices

-Mentor junior team members and contribute to team knowledge sharing



What We’re Looking For

-Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field

-4+ years in hands-on data engineering or backend data roles

-Deep SQL knowledge and PostgreSQL performance tuning

-Strong Python skills for data manipulation and scripting

-Experience with modern data stack: Airflow, dbt, Fivetran, Informatica, etc.

-Cloud experience (Azure) and CI/CD pipelines for data

-Strong grasp of ETL/ELT pipelines, orchestration, and data modeling

-Experience with MSP tool data (e.g., ConnectWise, Kaseya, Datto) is a big plus

-Understanding of data governance and regulatory compliance frameworks

-Willing to attend occasional once-a-month on-site department or leadership meetings. (Often none, but will provide an advance notice if there will be meetings.)



Nice to Have

-Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools

-Familiarity with Terraform or infrastructure-as-code

-Experience migrating from tools like BrightGauge

-Excellent written and verbal English communication



Why MSPbots?

-Be part of a high-impact team shaping the future of analytics and automation

-Competitive salary, paid US holidays, and growth potential

-$100 for Health Insurance, $20 for Life Insurance monthly reimbursement support

-Plus more, $20 for Dental and $4 for Vision reimbursements!

-Work with top-tier tech and build the foundations of our data ecosystem





Ready to build the future of MSP data intelligence? Apply at mspbots.ai!

title: Bookkeeper / Accountant
description:
We’re Midnighties, a one-person e-commerce business that sells through Shopify. We’re looking for someone to help keep our books accurate and give us clear monthly reporting, so we can free up more of our time. You’ll work directly with us.



The work

• Match Shopify payouts using QuickBooks and A2X.

• Reconcile our one bank account and one current credit card, and check prior periods, including when we had multiple credit cards.

• Review account balances and complete a one-time historical cleanup so transactions are correctly recorded on the balance sheet or P&L. Set up automation for future bookkeeping and leave the historical records clean and consistent.

• Handle monthly bookkeeping and prepare management reports that clearly summarize monthly results.



What we’re looking for

We need an intermediate-level bookkeeper or accountant with at least 2 years of experience managing the books for a Shopify e-commerce brand using QuickBooks and A2X, including monthly bookkeeping, reconciliations, and reporting. You’ll need clear written English for monthly reports and summaries. Must be able to work in Excel or Google Sheets.



You should be comfortable tracing small discrepancies, patient with month-end surprises, curious about what changed, steady when figures don’t tie, and skeptical of balances that look right.



You’ll have full control over the work and will need to think through and make recommendations for decisions that need to be taken. We expect work to be completed accurately and on time. The role also involves producing/automating weekly, monthly, quarterly reports, and occasional video calls to review work. You can choose your own hours as long as work is completed on time. We’re based in New York City and can communicate early in the morning or late at night to accommodate your workday.



This is a long-term independent contractor role with no set end date. There’s some room to take ownership of more work. We’ll provide logins to the tools you need. This role isn’t for someone looking for a short side job. We'd like someone to continue in this part-time role long term. A performance bonus is available.



Start: As soon as possible



Pay: $6/hour



To apply

• Send your resume.

Applications that skip these steps won’t be read.



Please answer:

When can you start, and how many hours a week can you work? Can you spend adequate time at the start to do a one time clean-up and historical reconciliation then move to a regular maintenance schedule?

title: Real Estate HDR Photo Editing Partner | Dedicated Editor
description:
ZABE Media is a growing real estate media company based in Austin, Texas. We're seeking an experienced individual HDR photo editor to join our production team, initially part-time, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time position.



We prioritize exceptional image quality, consistency, reliable turnaround, and professional communication. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work and wants to grow with our company.



THE OPPORTUNITY

- Starting pay of $5 USD/hour, negotiable based on experience, demonstrated quality, consistency, and efficiency.

- Initially part-time (approximately 20–30 hours per week), with the opportunity to transition to full-time as production grows.

- Current workload averages approximately 60–150 finished photos daily, with higher volume expected during busy season.

- Three-exposure HDR photography (-2, 0, +2 EV).

- Long-term opportunity with consistent work and growth potential.



EDITING REQUIREMENTS

- Professional HDR merging, color correction, natural lighting, and window balancing.

- Maintain straight verticals, realistic colors, and consistent quality across complete property galleries.

- Perform virtual twilight, virtual staging, sky replacement, grass enhancement/replacement, TV screen replacement, object removal, and custom retouching.

- Personally review completed images to ensure they meet ZABE's quality standards before submission.

- Complete revisions promptly and maintain consistent quality regardless of workload.



AI-assisted tools and efficient editing workflows are welcome, but every finished image must receive human review and refinement as needed.



SCHEDULE & TURNAROUND

- Work remotely on an agreed overnight schedule with U.S. Central Time.

- RAW photos are typically submitted by 8:00 PM Central Time.

- Completed galleries must be ready for internal QC by 8:00 AM Central Time the following morning.

- Availability during our morning QC period is required to address corrections and adjustments promptly.

- Schedule may expand as production increases, with hours agreed upon in advance.



QUALIFICATIONS

- At least 3 years of professional real estate photo editing experience preferred.

- Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom, or comparable editing software.

- Strong HDR editing, color correction, window balancing, and advanced retouching skills.

- Ability to produce approximately 100–150 premium-quality HDR images during a full working day, depending on project complexity.

- Reliable editing equipment, internet connection, and professional communication.

- Experience editing for U.S. real estate media companies is preferred.



HOW TO APPLY

Please provide:

1. Portfolio featuring before-and-after examples and complete property galleries.

2. Your editing experience and software used.

3. Your requested hourly rate in USD.

4. Your typical and maximum number of premium-quality HDR photos completed in an eight-hour shift.

5. Your availability for overnight production and morning QC revisions (U.S. Central Time).

6. Your experience with specialty editing, including virtual staging, twilight, and object removal.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid editing assessment using ZABE Media's RAW files. Finalists may participate in a paid production trial to evaluate editing quality, efficiency, and consistency.



We're looking for a talented, dependable editor who can become a valued long-term member of ZABE Media's production team.

title: E-commerce Product Catalog & Data Quality Specialist
description:
## About Catalogo



Catalogo is a Canadian AI-powered technology startup helping grocery stores, convenience stores, liquor stores, and other retailers digitize their product catalogs and sell online.



We're building a large, centralized product database and looking for a **highly detail-oriented E-commerce Product Catalog & Data Quality Specialist** to join our team part-time.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who enjoys researching products, organizing information, identifying mistakes, and ensuring every detail is accurate.



You'll work directly with our COO and play an important role in building a reliable, high-quality product database.



## What You'll Do



- Research and verify product information, including names, brands, sizes, categories, descriptions, and UPC/EAN barcodes.

- Cross-check product information against manufacturer websites and other reliable sources.

- Review product images to ensure they match the correct product, packaging, size, and variant.

- Identify duplicate products, incorrect information, missing details, and inconsistencies.

- Correct and standardize product information following our database guidelines.

- Review AI-generated product information and identify inaccuracies or hallucinations.

- Maintain organized spreadsheets and document sources used for verification.

- Flag information that cannot be confidently verified rather than making assumptions.

- Report recurring data issues and suggest improvements to our validation process.



## What We're Looking For



**Required Qualifications:**



- At least 2 years of experience in e-commerce product listings, catalog management, product research, data validation, or similar work.

- Experience working with Shopify, Amazon, or other e-commerce platforms.

- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify small inconsistencies.

- Strong proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel.

- Excellent internet research and fact-checking skills.

- Ability to work independently, follow instructions, and meet deadlines.

- Reliable, organized, and proactive in communicating questions or issues.



**English Proficiency (Important):**



- Upper-Intermediate to Advanced English (B2–C1 or higher).

- Excellent written English, including grammar, spelling, and reading comprehension.

- Ability to understand detailed product descriptions, manufacturer specifications, and technical information in English.

- Comfortable communicating professionally with our Canadian team.

- Able to clearly explain discrepancies, research findings, and data corrections in writing.



**Additional Skills That Will Make You Stand Out:**



- Experience managing large Shopify or Amazon product catalogs.

- Familiarity with SKUs, UPCs, EANs, GTINs, product variants, and inventory data.

- Experience researching grocery, food, beverages, liquor, or other consumer packaged goods.

- Experience reviewing product images for accuracy and quality.

- Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT and the ability to verify AI-generated information.

- Experience with product information management (PIM) systems or data quality assurance.



## Working Arrangements



- **Position:** Part-Time, Remote

- **Location:** Philippines

- **Hours:** 20 hours per week

- **Schedule:** Flexible, with some availability for communication with our Canadian team.

- **Compensation:** USD $300–$350 per month, depending on experience.

- **Opportunity:** Long-term collaboration with potential for increased responsibilities as Catalogo grows.



You'll work directly with our leadership team in a supportive environment where accuracy, reliability, and initiative are valued.



## How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application:



**1. E-commerce Experience:** Have you previously managed or verified product catalogs for Shopify, Amazon, or another e-commerce platform? Please describe your experience and how long you've been doing this work.



**2. Product Verification:** If you receive a product with a name, barcode, and image that don't match, how would you determine which information is correct?



**3. Research Skills:** What websites, tools, or methods do you normally use to research and verify product information?



**4. English Proficiency:** How would you rate your written English (B2, C1, or C2)? Have you previously worked with Canadian, American, or other English-speaking clients?



**5. Compensation & Availability:** What is your expected monthly salary in USD for 20 hours per week, and when would you be available to start?



**Important:** Please begin your application with the words **"Product Accuracy Matters"** so we know you've carefully read the job description.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short, **paid practical assessment** involving product research, data verification, and image matching.



We're looking for someone who takes genuine pride in accuracy, pays attention to the smallest details, and understands that getting information right is more important than simply completing tasks quickly.



If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!



**The Catalogo Team**

title: Sr. Full-Stack AI & WordPress Engineer: $10-$12/hr (RAG Pipelines, Elementor JSON Schemas, Multi-Tenant Architecture)
description:
We are an established digital agency scaling a proprietary AI-Powered Custom Web Design Engine. This system automates high-end website production for established client brands by ingesting raw discovery inputs (interview transcripts, brand PDFs,
 briefs, mood boards), passing them through a dual-tier RAG memory pipeline, and programmatically generating production-ready Elementor staging pages via the WordPress REST API.



Once a client approves an initial homepage demo, the platform locks the design tokens (typography, color palettes, button styles, container radii) and automatically rolls out cohesive interior child pages (About, Services, Case Studies, Contact).

We are not looking for someone who manually clicks inside page builders. We need a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who understands WordPress at an architectural level (JSON template structures, REST API schema injections, hook lifecycles) combined with hands-on mastery of multimodal LLM workflows, RAG pipelines, and vector database multi-tenancy.



Screening Process & How to Apply

We take our recruitment process seriously and are looking for candidates who have carefully reviewed the architectural scope of this role and can demonstrate genuine, hands-on experience in AI automation.



To be considered, please follow these application requirements:



Required Verification Phrase: Begin your application with the exact phrase:

"SYSTEM ARCHITECT: DESIGN AUTOMATION"



Applications that do not begin with this phrase may be automatically disqualified. This helps us identify candidates who have carefully read and followed the application instructions.



Video Introduction (Mandatory): Include a link to a short video introducing yourself. Tell us about your professional background, relevant experience, and why you are a strong fit for this role.

Showcase Your AI Automation Projects: In your video, walk us through at least two AI automation projects you have personally designed, developed, or implemented.

We want to understand:



The problem or business challenge each project addressed.

The AI tools, technologies, and automation platforms you used.

The architecture, workflows, and integrations you implemented.

The results, business impact, or measurable improvements achieved.

You may blur or conceal client names, sensitive information, credentials, and proprietary data to protect confidentiality. However, we expect you to demonstrate the actual functionality and technical capabilities of your work.



Important: The video introduction and demonstration of at least two completed AI automation projects are mandatory requirements. Applications submitted without a video link will not be considered.



We value practical expertise over theoretical knowledge. Show us what you have actually built, how you think, and what you can bring to the team.



In your submission, please also provide:

1. GitHub or Live Production Samples: Share 2–3 links showcasing backend code, custom WordPress REST API plugins, or programmatic JSON generators you have built.

2. AI / RAG Experience: Detail a specific project where you connected an LLM/vector database to an external CMS or web platform.

3. Architectural Approach: Briefly explain how you would programmatically map an LLM's structured JSON output into Elementor's _elementor_data post-meta format without breaking the page editor.

4. Availability: State your current weekly availability and how soon you can start.

5. And your updated resume.



(Applications who didn't provide the information requested above will be disqualified immediately.)



Regards,



Phong (Peter) Nguyen.

title: Experienced Appointment Confirmation Setter – US Phone Number – Trading Education
description:
I run a day trading education company. When someone books a call with us, I need one person who stays with them from the moment they book until they're on the Zoom. That's this role.



You're not booking appointments, and you're not selling. The calls are already booked. Your job is getting every booked client to show up, prepared.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Run a 3-way group text with the client and our team from the moment the call is booked. Text back and forth all the way to the appointment.

- Call the client before the appointment. Make sure they're engaged and still coming.

- Make sure they get the pre-call video, actually watch it, and tell you what they thought.

- Get them on the Zoom on time, prepared and ready.

- Keep a quick status note for each booked client: texted, called, watched the video, confirmed.



From booked to on the call, A to Z, it's on you.



HOW THE WORK FLOWS

Expect 8 to 25 booked calls a week. This isn't full-time and it isn't a shift. It's 5 minutes here, 5 minutes there, throughout the day. Some days that's 30 minutes total, some days it's 2 to 3 hours. You need to be available during Eastern hours and respond as needed.



You cover every day we have appointments, usually Monday through Saturday. On days with no appointments, you handle the normal follow-ups for whoever's booked next.



MUST HAVES (if you don't have both, please don't apply)

- A US phone number you already have and use. You'll use it every single day for client texts, group chats and calls. Our clients are in the US and they need to see a US number.

- Real experience as an appointment setter, or in appointment confirmation or show-rate work. This isn't a training role.



WHAT ELSE I NEED

- Clear, natural spoken English that US clients understand easily on the phone. This is the most important skill in the role. The voice recording is how I judge it.

- Natural, friendly texting. Short messages that sound like a real person, not a script.

- Follow-through. If someone goes quiet, you keep at it until you get an answer.

- Discretion. Client details stay private.



PAY

$300/month base. The first month is a trial. After that, I'm open to adding bonuses tied to show rate and other KPIs, depending on how it goes.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "Confirmed" so I know you read this. Then include:



1. A Loom or voice recording link, under 2 minutes: introduce yourself, read the voice test script below, then leave a 20-second voi
 for a client named Mike who didn't pick up the day before his call.

2. A client texts the night before: "Honestly I'm slammed, can we just push this to next week?" Write your exact reply, word for word.

3. A client booked 3 days ago, hasn't watched the pre-call video and isn't answering texts. Walk me through your next 48 hours, and write the first text you'd send.

4. Where have you done appointment setting or confirmation work, and for how long? What was the show rate when you started vs. when you finished, and what did you change?

5. Do you have a US phone number right now? Which service is it on? Can you be available Eastern hours, Mon-Sat? How many other jobs are you working right now?



Applications without the voice recording or without answers won't be considered.



VOICE TEST: read this out loud in your recording:

"Hey Mike, it's [your name] from the academy. Quick check-in before your call tomorrow at 4. Did you get a chance to watch the short video I sent over? It's about ten minutes and it'll make the call way more useful for you. Let me know what you thought. Talk soon."

title: Operations Associate, Cleaning & Inventory Management
description:
Location: Remote, Philippines preferred

Schedule: Full-time, 40+ hours per week, with rotating shifts within 8 a.m.–10 p.m. ET

Compensation: $6 USD per hour

Reports to: CEO



Tools: ClickUp, Guesty, Google Workspace, Grok Bots, and ChatGPT



About the role

Settled In Stays manages furnished short- and mid-term rentals. We’re looking for someone to own cleaning coordination and inventory management so every property is clean, stocked, and ready before guests arrive.



You’ll coordinate cleaners, verify cleaning quality, track linens and supplies, and arrange replenishment before shortages affect a stay. You’ll work closely with the CEO and operations team to resolve issues quickly and build reliable processes as we grow.



What you’ll own



Cleaning and turnover coordination

Schedule and confirm cleanings around checkouts, arrivals, reservation changes, and property access requirements.

Follow T-48 and T-12 turnover checks to confirm assignments, timing, access, and supplies.

Monitor cleaning progress, follow up on delays, and coordinate backup coverage when needed.

Communicate special instructions, including pet stays, extra laundry, deep cleans, and approved early arrivals or late departures.

Flag any risk to property readiness early and coordinate a clear plan for resolution.



Cleaning quality and property readiness

Review cleaner photos and completion checklists against property standards before guest arrival.

Identify missed areas, stained or damaged linens, missing amenities, and staging issues. Request corrections and verify completion.

Coordinate inspections, re-cleans, and follow-up visits when necessary.

Investigate cleaning complaints, arrange a timely response, and document what needs to improve.

Report damage and maintenance issues to the responsible teammate with photos, relevant details, and urgency.



Inventory, linens, and supplies

Maintain accurate records of linens, towels, toiletries, cleaning products, and other guest supplies across properties and storage locations.

Coordinate regular stock counts with cleaners and local support teams.

Maintain agreed minimum stock levels and reorder points based on occupancy, usage, and delivery times.

Arrange approved purchases, deliveries, and transfers between storage and properties. Confirm items arrive and reach the correct location.

Track missing, damaged, or worn items and coordinate replacements.

Compare pricing, consolidate orders where practical, and document purchases and receipts within approved budgets.



Cleaner accountability and internal operations

Help source and onboard cleaners, including sharing property checklists, photo requirements, access instructions, and supply locations.

Track cleaner reliability, recurring quality issues, and completion times. Follow through on corrective actions.

Review cleaning invoices against completed work and approved extras, flagging discrepancies before payment.

Keep ClickUp tasks, inventory records, and relevant Guesty notes current.

Provide clear shift handoffs and daily updates covering upcoming turnovers, unresolved issues, and replenishment needs.

Improve SOPs and checklists when recurring problems reveal a gap.



What you’ll need

1–2+ years of experience in short-term rentals, property management, hospitality operations, housekeeping coordination, or inventory management.

Experience coordinating cleaners or service providers and following tasks through to verified completion.

Strong written English and clear, professional communication with cleaners, guests, vendors, and teammates.

Strong attention to detail, particularly when reviewing photos, tracking supplies, and managing schedules.

Ability to prioritize multiple turnovers and resolve routine issues independently.

Experience with ClickUp, Asana, 
, or a similar task management tool.

Comfort using Google Workspace and spreadsheets to track stock, purchases, and operating records.



Nice to have

Experience with Guesty, Hostfully, OwnerRez, or another property management system.

Familiarity with cleaning checklists, photo-based quality checks, linen rotation, and laundry coordination.

Experience with purchasing, supplier coordination, stock reconciliation, or preparing new properties for launch.

Experience using AI tools to organize work and improve processes while checking their output for accuracy.



What success looks like in your first 90 days

No missed cleanings caused by scheduling or follow-up oversight.

Every turnover has a confirmed cleaner, completion deadline, and documented readiness check.

Cleaning issues are identified promptly, with corrections verified before arrival whenever possible.

Inventory records are current, and replenishment is arranged before supplies fall below agreed minimums.

Purchases, deliveries, and cleaning invoices are documented accurately.

Routine cleaning and inventory issues are handled independently, with clear escalation when needed.



Growth opportunity

Strong performers can grow into the Operations Manager role as Settled In Stays expands, with responsibility for leading operations staff, managing vendor performance, and making broader operating decisions.



We value initiative, sound judgment, and follow-through. We’re looking for someone who anticipates problems, brings solutions, and takes ownership through completion.



Hiring process

30-minute interview.

Paid practical assessment covering turnover coordination, a cleaning quality issue, and an inventory replenishment scenario.

Reference check.



How to apply

Please include:

A brief introduction and your relevant experience.

One example of a cleaning, turnover, or inventory issue you handled, including how you verified it was resolved.

The software and tools you’ve used.

Your current availability for rotating shifts within the stated coverage window.

The largest number of properties or weekly turnovers you’ve supported at one time.

The phrase “5-Star Operations” so we know you read the full posting.

title: Prior Authorization Specialist
description:
Position Summary

We're looking for someone who combines exceptional organization with exceptional people skills. Success in this role means taking ownership, anticipating problems, and following through until the job gets done. 



Core Responsibilities

Insurance Authorizations & Tracking

-Prepare and submit initial and ongoing insurance authorization requests, ensuring all required documentation is complete and accurate.

-Monitor pending authorizations, check for approvals, and proactively follow up with insurance companies.

-Maintain accurate authorization records, including approved dates, units, and supporting documentation.

-Identify upcoming authorization expirations and help prevent interruptions in patient care.

-Escalate complex authorization issues, denials, or discrepancies to the Insurance Specialist.



Physician Office & Referral Partner Communication

-Contact physician offices and referring clinics by phone, fax, and
 to obtain signed plans of care and other required documentation.

-Develop strong, lasting relationships with physician offices and referral partners, becoming a trusted, dependable contact who makes it easy for their teams to work with TeamUp Therapy. 

-Follow up persistently and respectfully on outstanding requests, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

-Maintain organized records of outreach attempts, responses, and next steps.



Documentation, Audits & Organization

-Upload and organize authorization approvals, signed plans of care, and other insurance documents in our electronic medical record system.

-Maintain and update authorization tracking spreadsheets and patient hold records.

-Conduct routine authorization audits to identify missing documentation, upcoming deadlines, or potential issues.

-Communicate proactively with the Insurance Specialist and clinical team regarding authorization status, delays, and outstanding needs.



Additional Administrative Support

-Cross-train on key intake and scheduling responsibilities to provide backup coverage when needed.

-Help identify opportunities to improve workflows, efficiency, and the overall patient experience.



Must-Have Skills & Experience

-Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with confidence and professionalism on phone calls.

-Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.

-Strong relationship-building skills, with a warm, personable, and persistent communication style.

-Ability to work independently, take initiative, and consistently follow through on tasks.

-Strong computer skills and comfort using Google Sheets, Docs, and other web-based platforms.

-Willingness to learn new systems, adapt to changing processes, and take on additional responsibilities.

-Experience working remotely with a reliable internet connection and professional work environment.



Preferred Qualifications

-Previous experience managing U.S. healthcare prior authorizations is strongly preferred, particularly in pediatric speech, occupational, or physical therapy. 

-Familiarity with electronic medical records, insurance portals, or healthcare practice management software.

-Experience communicating with physician offices, referral partners, or insurance companies.

-Spanish fluency is a plus.



Schedule & Work Environment

-Weekly Hours: 40 hours/week (full-time)

-Work Hours: 9am- 5pm ET, Monday–Friday

-Location: Remote

-Training: Initial onboarding, SOP-based training, and ongoing support from our Insurance Specialist and administrative team



Compensation & Classification

-Type: Independent Contractor

-Hourly Rate: $7.00 USD per hour

-Performance Bonuses: Eligible for quarterly performance bonuses based on individual performance and contributions to team goals



Success Metrics

-Authorization requests are submitted accurately and on time, minimizing interruptions in patient care.

-Outstanding signed plans of care and required documentation are obtained through consistent, proactive follow-up.

-Referral partners and physician offices experience warm, responsive, and professional communication.

-Authorization records, tracking systems, and patient hold lists remain accurate and up to date.

-The broader administrative team receives reliable backup support when needed.



About TeamUp Therapy

TeamUp Therapy is a pediatric telehealth practice providing speech and occupational therapy to families across Georgia. We believe in removing barriers to care—making therapy ultra-convenient, family-centered, and accessible without unnecessary wait times.



Our mission is to help every child reach their full potential through compassionate, high-quality care.



Our team is guided by three core values: Solve Problems, Communicate Clearly, and Empower Families. We're a collaborative, growing organization that values initiative, accountability, and people who genuinely care about making a difference.

Please record a short video introducing yourself and answering the following questions:

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
# We Are Hiring: Senior Graphic Designer 



We're hiring a **senior-level** freelance graphic designer for a long-term, ongoing, month-to-month role. This is not an entry- or mid-level position — we're looking for a seasoned professional who works independently, catches their own mistakes, and delivers polished, print-ready work with minimal oversight.



## What Senior-Level Means for This Role



You should be able to:

- Manage your own projects and timelines, hitting deadlines without being chased.

- Take a brief and run with it — asking smart clarifying questions up front, then executing without hand-holding.

- Catch and fix small errors in client-supplied content (inconsistent capitalization, awkward line breaks, etc.) as a matter of habit, not as an afterthought.

- Know the difference between "technically correct" and "actually good" — and default to the latter.

- Recognize the edges of your own expertise and flag it early, rather than guessing.



## Required Skills



- Expert-level Adobe Creative Suite: InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop.

- Prepress knowledge: color conversion for print, file packaging, print-ready output.

- Strong typography: rag control, kerning, and overall type craft.

- Real-world client experience — you've worked with brand guidelines, client feedback cycles, and revision requests.

- Exceptional attention to detail and precise adherence to instructions.

- Creative problem-solving, not just execution.



## Bonus Skills



- WordPress, especially DIVI.

- Content writing.

- Illustration.



## Typical Projects



- Website mockups in Photoshop or Figma.

- Print brochure layout (including multipage brochures).

- Print ad design and updates.

- Brand identity design.



## How We Work



- Projects are managed in Trello and typically assigned early in the week.

- Any questions about an assignment should come within a day or two of receiving it.

- All working files live on our shared cloud drive — no local-only files.

- Time is tracked via our time-tracking software.

- You'll be given brand assets, working files, and access to stock image/graphic libraries as needed.

- **Deadlines:** typical internal turnaround is one week per project. Deadlines are firm — we expect every deadline to be hit, with early delivery whenever possible.

- **Time zone:** you set your own working hours. About once or twice a month, you may need to be available for a call or meeting during our overlap window, which may fall as early as 8am or as late as 8pm EST.

- **Software:** you're expected to maintain your own active Adobe Creative Suite subscription. Stock assets and project-specific files are provided by us.



---



## How to Apply



Applications that don't follow these instructions will not be reviewed. 



Please submit:



1. **Portfolio** — at least 10 work samples. Prioritize longer-form work (reports, full ad campaigns, white papers). Limit to a maximum of 2 logo/brand samples and 2 social media samples.

2. **Resume/CV.**

3. A short explanation of what makes you uniquely qualified for a **senior-level** role like this one.

4. Any "Required Skills" you don't currently have — and why you should still be considered.

5. Any "Bonus Skills" you have (or other relevant skills not listed above).

6. To confirm you've read this entire posting carefully: skip this question, and instead begin your response to question 3 with the word "Confirmed."

7. Your availability for a video interview in the next week (days/times in EST).

8. Your weekly availability (hours per week).

title: Technical Account Engineer (MSP) – Infrastructure, Cloud & Projects

We are seeking a consultative and technically proficient Technical Account Engineer (MSP) to serve as the primary technical advisor and relationship lead for a portfolio of business clients.



Are you an experienced IT systems engineer or solutions consultant who thrives at the intersection of architecture, project execution, and strategic client advisory? If you enjoy translating complex business challenges into resilient cloud and infrastructure designs, driving end-to-end project cutovers, and serving as the trusted technical authority for business leaders, this role was built for you.



We bridge the gap between high-level consulting and real-world engineering. As our Technical Account Engineer (MSP), you will oversee the full lifecycle of client technology: from initial discovery, solution design, and SOW scoping, to hands-on project delivery, ongoing infrastructure roadmap reviews, and high-level escalation engineering. We back our team with direct leadership mentorship, company-paid certifications, and a culture that values engineering craftsmanship and ownership.



Key Responsibilities



1. Client Discovery & Pre-Sales Engineering



* Technical Discovery & Audits: Lead deep-dive architectural assessments to uncover client infrastructure bottlenecks, security gaps, and technical requirements.

* Solution Architecture: Design practical and secure solutions across Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, hybrid networking, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and virtualization.

* Scoping & Effort Estimation: Prepare accurate technical scopes, architectural diagrams, work breakdown structures, and resource/effort estimates for Statements of Work (SOWs).

* Client Presentations & Demos: Partner with Account Managers to present technical solutions, explain business ROI, and address client technical concerns.

* Sales Handoff: Own the formal technical handoff from sales into engineering delivery to guarantee scope fidelity and eliminate assumptions.



2. Strategic Technical Account Management



* Trusted Advisory: Act as the primary technical advisor for an assigned portfolio of US business clients.

* Health Reviews & Roadmapping: Conduct annual IT assessments, evaluating cloud security posture, hardware lifecycles, system performance, and more.

* Proactive Gap Remediation: Analyze recurring operational tickets to diagnose chronic IT issues, proposing technical solutions rather than temporary workarounds.

* Escalated Consultation: Advise clients and support teammates through urgent technical dilemmas, compliance changes, disaster scenarios, and business expansion needs.



3. Escalation & Support Engineering (L2/L3)



* High-Severity Troubleshooting: Serve as the escalation point for critical issues and complex infrastructure i
.

* Technical Mentorship: Provide root-cause guidance and technical coaching to frontline support technicians.

* Remediation Plans: Engineer and deploy long-term technical remediation plans for root-cause issues uncovered during major i
.

* Knowledge Management: Author, review, and curate internal knowledge base articles, standard operating guides, and technical baselines.



What We Are Looking For



* Relevant Experience: 3 to 5+ years of hands-on systems administration, technical account management, or solutions engineering experience, with solid exposure to Managed Service Provider (MSP) environments.

* Cloud & Hybrid Infrastructure: Deep working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), Intune, Azure Virtual Desktop/IaaS, Windows Server environments, Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, and Group Policy.

* Networking & Security Acumen: Proven competency configuring firewalls (Fortinet, SonicWall, Ubiquiti, or Meraki), VLANs, site-to-site VPNs, endpoint detection and response (EDR), and backup/disaster recovery systems (Datto, Veeam, Acronis).



* Scoping & Delivery Discipline: Demonstrated track record scoping technical projects, building SOW effort estimations, and successfully executing clean cutovers with documented procedures.

* Executive-Level Communication: Flawless verbal and written English communication skills, with an ability to clearly convey technical risk and value to executive business owners and IT stakeholders alike.

* Remote Reliability: Dedicated home office located in NCR or nearby, equipped with high-speed, redundant internet connections and secondary power backup.

* Schedule & Setup: Comfortable working US business hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST / overnight in the Philippines) from a dedicated home office with reliable high-speed internet and power backup.



Nice to Have:



* Prior experience working within a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment or using RMM/PSA tools.

* Hands-on exposure to firewall configurations (Ubiquiti, Cisco, Fortinet), VLANs, VPNs, or tenant-to-tenant migrations.

* Foundational industry certifications (CompTIA Network+/Security+, Microsoft Certified: Fundamentals / Azure Administrator, or CCNA).

* Familiarity with centralized documentation platforms.



Why Join Cloudavize?



Work directly with US business leaders and help implement practical, high-impact technology solutions.

* Collaborate with a supportive US and global team of account managers, project specialists, and service delivery engineers.

What Sets Us Apart?

* Continuous Learning: We invest in your professional growth with company-paid certifications and technical training.

title: Senior Graphic Designer – Print, Layout & Brand (InDesign/Illustrator)
description:
SENIOR GRAPHIC DESIGNER – LONG-TERM, REMOTE, SET YOUR OWN HOURS



Nicole Steffen Design is a U.S. design and marketing studio based in Northern Michigan. We create brochures, annual reports, ads, websites and brand identities for nonprofits, community organizations and established businesses. We're looking for a senior-level graphic designer to join our small team on a long-term, ongoing basis.



This role is for an experienced professional who works independently, catches their own mistakes, and delivers polished, print-ready work with minimal oversight. If you take real pride in type and layout, we'd love to hear from you.



WHY WORK WITH US

- Long-term, ongoing work (month-to-month, no fixed end date)

- Set your own working hours

- Paid weekly for every hour you track

- Briefs, files, brand assets and stock libraries provided

- Meaningful projects include nonprofits and community organizations

- A small team where good craft gets noticed and valued



WHAT SENIOR-LEVEL MEANS HERE

You:

- Manage your own projects and timelines, and hit deadlines without being chased

- Take a brief and run with it: ask smart clarifying questions up front, then execute without hand-holding

- Fix small errors in client-supplied content (inconsistent capitalization, awkward line breaks, widows and orphans) as a habit, not an afterthought

- Know the difference between "technically correct" and "actually good," and default to the latter

- Know the edges of your expertise and flag them early rather than guessing



REQUIRED SKILLS

- Expert-level Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop

- Prepress: CMYK conversion, bleeds, preflight, file packaging and print-ready PDF output

- Strong typography: rag control, kerning, hierarchy and overall type craft

- Real client experience: brand guidelines, feedback cycles and revision requests

- Exceptional attention to detail and precise adherence to instructions

- Creative problem-solving, not just execution



BONUS SKILLS

- Figma

- WordPress, especially Divi

- Content writing

- Illustration



TYPICAL PROJECTS

- Multipage print brochures and reports

- Print ad design and updates

- Brand identity design

- Website mockups in Photoshop or Figma



HOW WE WORK

- Projects are managed in Trello and usually assigned early in the week

- Questions about an assignment should come within 1–2 days of receiving it

- All working files live on our shared cloud drive (no local-only files)

- Time is tracked with our time-tracking software

- Typical turnaround is one week+ per project. Deadlines are firm, and early delivery is always appreciated

- Once or twice a month, you may need to join a call between 8am and 8pm U.S. Eastern Time

- You maintain your own active Adobe Creative Cloud subscription. We provide stock assets, project files, and any supporting tools/software.



PAY AND HOURS

- $10 USD per hour to start, paid weekly

- 15–25 hours per week, with room to grow



HIRING PROCESS

1. Application review

2. Short video interview

3. Paid test project: finalists complete a realistic layout project (up to 10 hours), paid at $10/hour. It's how we see your typography, prepress and attention to detail in action, and how you see what working with us is like.





HOW TO APPLY

Please follow these instructions exactly. Attention to detail is a core part of this role, and we won't review applications that skip steps.



Send:

1. PORTFOLIO: a link (website, Behance, Google Drive or PDF) with at least 10 work samples. Prioritize longer-form work (reports, multipage brochures, full ad campaigns, white papers). Include no more than 2 logo/brand samples and no more than 2 social media samples. For each piece, note your role (for example "full design," "layout only" or "team project").

2. RESUME/CV.

3. A short explanation of what makes you uniquely qualified for a senior-level role like this one.

4. Any Required Skills you don't currently have, and why you should still be considered.

5. Any Bonus Skills you have, or other relevant skills not listed above.

6. To confirm you've read this entire posting carefully: skip this question, and instead begin your answer to question 3 with the word "Confirmed."

7. Your availability for a video interview in the next two weeks (days and times in U.S. Eastern Time).

8. How many hours per week you're available.

title: SENIOR META ADS MEDIA BUYER
description:
We’re looking for an experienced, analytical, and results-driven Meta Ads Media Buyer to manage multiple advertising accounts for our businesses.



You must know how to turn advertising budgets into qualified leads, booked appointments, and actual sales. We need someone who can develop strategy independently, troubleshoot problems, and take ownership of performance.



We measure success by business results—not vanity metrics.



If your experience is limited to boosting posts, launching basic campaigns, or following instructions without understanding the strategy, do not apply.



Work Schedule and Required Commitment



Required schedule: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM EST.



This role requires your undivided professional attention throughout scheduled working hours. You must be available, responsive, and actively focused on your responsibilities.



If you have another job, freelance work, client accounts, or business commitments that overlap with 8:00 AM–5:00 PM EST, do not apply. This requirement is strict and non-negotiable.



You may not perform work for another employer or client during our scheduled working hours. Being logged in while dividing your attention between multiple jobs does not meet our expectations.



Key Responsibilities



- Manage, optimize, and scale multiple
 and Instagram ad accounts.

- Drive qualified leads, booked appointments, and sales.

- Research audiences and competitors; test targeting, creatives, copy, and offers.

- Manage budgets, bidding, retargeting, and conversion funnels.

- Set up and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, CAPI, and conversion tracking.

- Monitor costs, lead quality, conversions, and ROAS; resolve underperformance quickly.

- Report results and recommended actions while maintaining Meta policy compliance.



Required Qualifications



- Only applicants with proven, hands-on Meta Ads experience will be considered.

- At least 3 years of experience managing Meta campaigns, multiple ad accounts, and advertising budgets.

- Advanced proficiency in Meta Business Manager, Ads Manager, Events Manager, and reporting tools.

- Strong experience in lead generation, conversion optimization, retargeting, and scaling.

- Practical knowledge of Meta Pixel, CAPI, attribution, and conversion tracking.

- Proven ability to turn campaign data into actions that generate qualified sales opportunities.

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent English communication and clear, actionable reporting.

- Strong organization, accountability, and the ability to work independently.

- Experience with local services, fitness, wellness, or multi-location brands is a major advantage.



Non-Negotiable Work Requirements



1. Dedicated Availability

You must work the required 8:00 AM–5:00 PM EST schedule and give this role your undivided attention. Other jobs or client commitments must not overlap with these hours.



2. Mandatory Time Tracking

You must use our designated time-tracking software while working. Accurate time tracking is required, and compliance will be monitored.



3. Mandatory Zoom Breakout Room Presence

You must be available and present in our designated Zoom breakout room during scheduled working hours, according to company policy.



4. Accountability and Communication



You must provide consistent updates, respond promptly during working hours, and take ownership of campaign performance. We expect you to identify issues, explain what the data shows, and follow through on corrective actions.



If you cannot meet the schedule, dedicated-attention requirement, time tracking, or Zoom requirements, do not apply.



Benefits



- 10 days of paid time off (PTO).

- Remote work within a structured, collaborative team.

- The opportunity to manage campaigns across multiple businesses and locations.



How to Apply



Use this exact application subject-line format, replacing the bracketed text with your full name:



META ADS EXPERT – READY TO START – [YOUR FULL NAME]



Example:



META ADS EXPERT – READY TO START – Juan Dela Cruz



In your application, include:



A brief summary of your Meta Ads experience, including the number of accounts and typical monthly budgets you have managed.



Relevant campaign examples showing measurable results. Include your role, campaign period, budget, and outcomes such as qualified leads, booked appointments, or sales.



Explicit confirmation that you can work 8:00 AM–5:00 PM EST with no overlapping employment, freelance work, or client commitments.



Confirmation that you agree to the required time tracking and Zoom breakout room presence.



Applications that do not use the exact subject-line format or omit any required application item will be marked “Instructions not followed” and will not be considered.



Please read the full posting before applying. Following these instructions is the first step in demonstrating the attention to detail and accountability this role requires.

title: SportsBetting trader
description:
I am looking to hire a dedicated and highly motivated Sports Betting Trader to assist with identifying and executing betting opportunities across platforms such as bet365, Sportsbet and other major bookmakers.



Your primary responsibility will be using BetSniper to identify betting opportunities, analyse the available information and execute the relevant bets accurately and efficiently.



I will provide all the necessary tools, software, information and sources required to perform the role. I will also personally guide you through the entire process, teaching you how to use BetSniper and the other platforms.



Training can take anywhere from a few days to 1–2 weeks, depending on how quickly you learn and adapt to the system. You will gradually be given more responsibility as your understanding and confidence improve.



I am looking for someone who is genuinely committed, hardworking and willing to put in the hours required. This is not a casual position – I need someone who is prepared to work consistently, handle a high volume of opportunities and maintain excellent accuracy throughout their shifts.



Additional skills required



- Exceptional attention to detail – Must double-check selections, odds, stakes and markets before submitting.

- Odds analysis – Understand decimal odds, implied probability, value betting and price movements.

- EV understanding – Ability to understand Expected Value (EV), identify positive EV opportunities and prioritise the best bets.

- Bankroll management – Understand staking plans, exposure limits and bankroll preservation.

- Decision-making under pressure – Remain calm when odds move quickly or opportunities disappear.

- Adaptability – Quickly learn new platforms, betting tools, systems and workflows.

- Strong communication – Provide regular updates, report issues immediately and communicate clearly. 

- Reliability and punctuality – Consistently show up for assigned shifts and remain available throughout.

- Integrity and confidentiality – Keep betting strategies, accounts, data and operational information private.

- Problem-solving – Quickly identify rejected bets, platform errors, suspended markets and discrepancies.

- Multitasking – Monitor multiple platforms and betting feeds simultaneously.

- Consistency – Follow instructions and established procedures rather than making impulsive decisions.

- Computer proficiency – Comfortable navigating multiple browser tabs, spreadsheets, dashboards and software tools.



Additional responsibilities 

1. Monitor live odds and betting opportunities continuously.

2. Execute bets within strict timeframes.

3. Ensure stakes and selections match the provided instructions exactly.

4. Maintain an accurate record of every placed, rejected and missed bet.

5. Track account balances, betting limits and available exposure.

6. Report unusual odds movements and discrepancies.

7. Follow risk-management procedures without deviation.

8. Be available for extended sessions during busy sporting periods.



Working Hours



Approximately 6-12 hours per day.



Occasional overnight shifts may be required.



Consistent availability and reliability are essential.



Work hard work well, work overnights when needed and pay will remain high for the hours.

• Help streamline
 marketing, CRM management, and customer engagement.

applications.

, and similar tools.

We are a US–TX–based company that builds software and provides related services to healthcare organizations supporting their staff credentialing and learning needs.



We are seeking a Credentialing Specialist with a minimum of 2 years of experience in US-based medical staff insurance credentialing/enrollment. This position is full-time (35-40 hours per week). Because we are based in the US, you must be available to work Monday–Friday, between 8:00am–6:00pm US Central Time.

* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with US medical staff insurance credentialing or payor enrollment; working knowledge of CAQH, PECOS, Availity, and TMHP systems are strongly preferred.

* Proficiency using web-based business software (MS Word, Outlook/Gmail, Excel, Google Docs, Google Sheets, etc.)

* Excellent communication and follow-up abilities with English-speaking clients

* Reliable computer and internet connection

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet deadlines in a remote environment.



Responsibilities:

* Maintain provider enrollment information in the credentialing database; generate reports for hospital administration, billing staff, and clinic managers as needed

* Evaluate credentialing/privileging requests and practitioner documentation (education, training, experience) for eligibility

* Compile and present practitioner data for review by appropriate committees or administrators

* Investigate and resolve discrepancies or adverse findings in credentialing information

* Support audits and surveys by regulatory and accreditation agencies

* Obtain and review practitioner sanctions, complaints, and adverse data to ensure compliance

description:
About us

Anton Petrov Consulting LLC runs an in-house performance marketing team based in Cyprus. We run TikTok Spark ads on CPA offers — reward apps and mobile games — across European markets, and the team is growing. We fund all ad spend and give you the ad accounts, tools and the winning ads that already work for us. Your job is to test, find what converts, and scale it.



What you'll do

- Run TikTok Spark ad campaigns on one assigned CPA offer (reward or mobile-gaming app) across European markets (Germany/Austria/Switzerland, Nordics, France, UK, Poland, Italy, Netherlands, Belgium)

- Write and test new hooks every day using our testing system (5 hooks per test, one variable at a time)

- Kill losing ad groups fast and step budgets up gradually on winners

- Keep every ad inside TikTok's advertising policies — no income claims, no fake app screens or fake notifications

- Send a short daily report: spend, results, ROAS, hooks tested, what you killed



What we want

- Hands-on TikTok Ads Manager experience — you have run and paid for your own campaigns, not just watched courses

- Prior CPA / affiliate media buying experience is strongly preferred — if you have run CPA, affiliate or app-install offers, tell us which verticals and what results

- Meta Ads experience is a plus

- Strong written English — you'll write hooks and ad briefs for European audiences

- Comfortable with numbers: ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM

- Reliable internet (25 Mbps+), backup power or backup connection, and your own laptop



Pay — how it works

- USD 400 per month base, paid every month in full.

- Plus 20% of the net profit from your campaigns, paid monthly. Net profit = revenue your campaigns generate minus the ad spend on your campaigns. We pay all the ad spend — you never risk your own money.

- Losses carry forward: if your campaigns end a month at a loss, that loss is subtracted from the next month's profit before the 20% is calculated. The profit share is paid once your running total is back in profit. The USD 400 base is never reduced.

- Example: month 1 your campaigns make $2,000 profit → you get $400 + $400 = $800. If instead month 1 is −$300 and month 2 is +$1,300, month 2's share is 20% of $1,000 = $200 (plus your $400 base each month).

- Paid monthly via Wise, Payoneer or OnlineJobs.ph Easypay.

- 21-day trial on a capped daily ad budget. After the trial we d
 on results (ROAS), not effort. Base pay is paid for the trial period too.

- Strong performers can have the profit share reviewed upward after 3 months.



Hours

- Full time, Monday to Friday, 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM Manila time (our European morning and afternoon)

- Occasional short weekend checks on live campaigns



How to apply (read carefully — applications that skip this are not read)

1. Start your application with the code word SPARKFIRE.

2. Send proof: screenshots of your TikTok Ads Manager and/or Meta Ads Manager (campaign view showing spend and results) and of your affiliate network dashboard (stats/earnings view). You may blur names and IDs, but spend and results must be visible. No screenshots = no interview.

3. Answer these 3 questions:

   - How much have you personally spent in TikTok Ads Manager (total, and in your best month), and what was the ROAS or CPA on your best campaign?

   - Which CPA / affiliate offers or verticals have you run, and on which traffic sources?

   - In 2–3 sentences: what is a Spark ad, and why would you use one instead of a regular in-feed ad?

4. Attach a speed test screenshot from your work setup.



Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test task (5 TikTok hooks + 1 ad brief, USD 25), then a 30-minute video call.
