title: Finance and Accounting Manager (CPA or CFA required)
description:
About DataTel

DataTel is a security-first technology partner providing managed IT, cybersecurity, business voice and telephony, networking, and 24/7 Security Operations Center services. We help organizations make technology, security, compliance, and communications feel steady, human, and under control. We run the company on EOS (Traction) and are investing in AI and automation across the business, including our back office.



The Role

We are looking for a tech-forward accounting leader who can both own the work and improve the system. This person will be responsible for DataTel's day-to-day accounting operations, including billing, accounts receivable, collections, payables, payroll coordination, month-end close, reporting, forecasting, and vendor relationships.

This is not a role for someone who only wants to process a queue or maintain the status quo. We want a hands-on systems builder who finds the root cause of problems, uses AI and automation to remove manual work, documents repeatable processes, and treats the company's financial results like an owner would.

A major early priority will be evaluating the work currently handled by outside bookkeeping and accounting partners, recommending what should remain outsourced versus move in-house, and building a finance function that is faster, more accurate, scalable, and cost-effective.



What You'll Own

Strategy & Finance Function Development

▪   Set the direction for DataTel's finance function and build a practical 12- to 24-month improvement roadmap.

▪   Evaluate bookkeeping, payroll, tax, and other finance activities to determine what should be handled in-house, outsourced, or automated based on cost, quality, risk, and capacity.

▪   Prioritize and execute finance improvement projects with leadership, operations, and DataTel's technical and automation resources.

▪   Monitor improvements after launch, resolve issues, measure results, and keep documentation current.

Accounting, Close & Financial Reporting

▪   Own full-cycle bookkeeping and accounting in accounting software such as QuickBooks Online, Xero, or a comparable platform, including the chart of accounts, journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations, and accurate general ledger coding.

▪   Lead a timely and accurate month-end and year-end close using a documented checklist and supporting schedules.

▪   Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and a leadership-ready reporting package that includes the P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, and key performance indicators.

▪   Coordinate with outside bookkeeping partners and the company's CPA on record accuracy, tax planning, preparation, filings, and owner tax distribution estimates.

▪   Maintain clean, diligence-ready books and support the integration of acquired companies' financial information when needed.

▪   Support SBA lender reporting, loan compliance, required financial statements, tax returns, and covenant calculations.

Billing, Accounts Receivable & Collections

▪   Review service tickets, projects, and client agreements for billable work and generate accurate, timely invoices through 



DataTel's PSA and billing systems.

▪   Verify that recurring agreement billing matches contracted services and resolve billing adjustments, credit memos, prorated charges, and invoice corrections.

▪   Own the accounts receivable ledger end to end, including payment application, unapplied cash, aging management, disputes, refunds, chargebacks, and NSF payments.

▪   Run a consistent and professional collections process across current, 31–60 day, and 60+ day balances, escalating issues when needed.

▪   Match customer payments from checks, ACH, and online payment platforms to bank deposits and resolve variances.

▪   Provide accurate and timely revenue data to third-party telecom compliance resources supporting FCC Form 499, USF, and related filings.



Payables, Vendors, Spend & Cost Control

▪   Own accounts payable and spend management, including approval workflows, invoice coding, receipts, and appropriate leadership approval for larger payments and new vendors.

▪   Serve as a primary finance contact for vendors regarding invoices, account questions, and disputes.

▪   Partner with operations on vendor bill reconciliation and contract pricing analysis, including identifying margin gaps, billing errors, and preventable cost leakage.

▪   Review software subscriptions and overhead spending to identify savings and improve cost control.

▪   Maintain appropriate inventory tracking and valuation for voice and network equipment.



Planning, Analysis & Compliance

▪   Lead the annual budget, rolling cash-flow forecast, and budget-versus-actual reporting.

▪   Maintain an accurate calendar of recurring filings and renewals, including business licenses, annual reports, personal property tax returns, state business taxes, and insurance renewals.

▪   Develop and maintain finance Scorecard measures in EOS, such as days to close, DSO, accounts receivable over 60 days, cash position, billing accuracy, and gross margin by service line.

▪   Participate in the appropriate weekly Level 10 meeting and own quarterly Rocks related to the finance function.

▪   Build models and provide analysis that supports pricing, profitability, cash management, and growth decisions.

Systems, Automation, AI & Documentation

▪   Use AI tools as part of daily work to accelerate reconciliations, transaction coding, variance analysis, reporting, collection communications, data cleanup, and documentation.

▪   Design, build, and maintain secure automations and integrations across accounting software, the PSA and billing system, spend-management tools, CRM, payment platforms, and banking workflows.

▪   Evaluate AI, fintech, and automation tools with a security-first mindset, including data handling, access permissions, system ownership, and vendor terms.

▪   Write and maintain clear SOPs so every finance process is documented, repeatable, auditable, and not dependent on one person.

▪   Partner with technical resources when APIs, Power Automate, Zapier, Make, Power Query, Python, or Model Context Protocol integrations can remove manual work.

▪   Protect confidential financial, payroll, client, and employee information and follow DataTel's security and access-control requirements.



How Our Core Values Show Up in This Role

▪   Help First: You are a resource to the whole company. When a team needs a margin check, billing fix, report, or answer to a client invoice question, you help get it solved.

▪   Do What You Say You’re Going to Do: The close happens when promised, reports arrive on time, and potential delays are communicated early and clearly.

▪   Be the Solution: You do not stop at identifying a problem. You recommend and implement a fix, then address the root cause so the issue does not repeat.

▪   Work Smart: When work is repetitive, you look for a secure, sustainable way to automate it, simplify it, or eliminate it.

What We're Looking For

▪   An accounting or finance degree. Contador Público or an equivalent qualification is appropriate for Argentina-based candidates.

▪   At least 6 years of progressive accounting experience, including ownership of full-cycle bookkeeping and month-end close for a US-based company.

▪   Strong understanding of US GAAP, accrual accounting, reconciliations, financial statements, and revenue recognition for recurring services.

▪   Advanced proficiency in accounting software such as QuickBooks Online, Xero, or similar platforms, along with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivot tables, data cleanup, and financial modeling.

▪   Hands-on experience with billing, accounts receivable, collections, accounts payable, payroll, and general accounting.

title: Senior Bookkeeper | Full-Cycle Accounting, AP/AR & Month-End Close
description:
Senior Bookkeeper | Full-Cycle Accounting, AP/AR & Month-End Close



Salary: PHP 45,000 per month

Schedule: Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours

Location: Philippines-based candidates only



We are hiring an experienced Senior Bookkeeper to support the finance team of a U.S.-based company.



This role requires strong accounting fundamentals, practical QuickBooks experience, and the ability to take ownership of daily bookkeeping, accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, and assigned month-end close activities.



You should be comfortable reviewing existing records, identifying errors, investigating discrepancies, and bringing unresolved items to a clear resolution. We need someone who understands how transactions affect the financial statements and can recognize when an entry or account balance needs further review.



Key Responsibilities



• Manage day-to-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks, ensuring accurate account coding, appropriate accounting treatment, and complete supporting documentation

• Own assigned AP workflows, including bill review, approval tracking, payment preparation, vendor statement reconciliation, and discrepancy resolution

• Manage assigned AR activities, including invoicing, payment application, aging review, and follow-up on outstanding or unapplied balances

• Independently reconcile bank and credit card accounts, investigating missing, duplicate, incorrectly recorded, or unmatched transactions

• Reconcile balance sheet accounts and maintain supporting schedules for assigned accounts

• Prepare and post supported journal entries, including accruals, prepayments, and corrections, subject to required review and approval

• Support month-end close by completing reconciliations, reviewing account activity, and identifying missing entries or unusual balances

• Review AP and AR aging reports and investigate old, inconsistent, or unexplained items

• Prepare routine financial reports and explain significant discrepancies or unusual activity to the finance team

• Identify recurring bookkeeping problems and recommend practical improvements to processes and controls

• Maintain a clear list of outstanding items, communicate progress, and follow each issue through to completion



Required Experience & Skills



• At least four years of hands-on bookkeeping or accounting experience, including direct support for a U.S.-based business

• Professional QuickBooks experience managing full-cycle bookkeeping, including reconciliations, journal entries, and reporting

• Demonstrated responsibility for both accounts payable and accounts receivable

• Experience independently completing bank and credit card reconciliations and resolving discrepancies

• Hands-on experience supporting month-end close and reconciling balance sheet accounts

• Strong understanding of debits and credits, accrual accounting, the chart of accounts, and how transactions affect the balance sheet and profit and loss statement

• Ability to distinguish expenses from assets, recognize prepaid expenses and accrued liabilities, and identify transactions requiring clarification

• Experience handling high transaction volumes while meeting recurring deadlines

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, SUMIFS, pivot tables, and reconciliation schedules

• Clear written and spoken English, including the ability to explain accounting issues and request missing information

• Sound judgment, strong attention to detail, and consistent follow-through

• Ability to manage recurring responsibilities independently and raise issues before they delay reporting or payments

• Consistent availability and prompt communication during agreed U.S. business hours



Preferred Qualifications



• Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

• Experience maintaining books for multiple entities or business units

• Experience cleaning up historical bookkeeping errors or reconciling accounts with unresolved balances

• Experience working directly with a U.S. accountant, Controller, or finance manager

• QuickBooks certification supported by substantial practical experience



Please Read Before Applying



We are looking for an experienced accounting professional who can take ownership of assigned work with limited day-to-day supervision.



You must be able to explain the accounting behind your entries, describe the accounts you personally reconciled, and provide examples of discrepancies you investigated and resolved. Experience limited to data entry, invoice encoding, bank-feed matching, or bookkeeping courses will not meet the requirements of this position.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical assessment covering reconciliations, correcting entries, AP/AR discrepancies, and month-end accounting.



How to Apply



Please include:



• Your resume and OnlineJobs.ph profile link

• Your years of relevant experience, including experience supporting U.S.-based businesses

• The QuickBooks versions you have used professionally and the bookkeeping functions you personally managed

• A brief summary of your AP, AR, and reconciliation responsibilities, including approximate monthly transaction volume

• Your specific responsibilities during month-end close, including accounts reconciled and journal entries prepared

• One example of a challenging reconciliation or bookkeeping issue, how you investigated it, and how you resolved it

• Your availability during U.S. business hours and earliest start date



Work Requirements



• Based in the Philippines

• Available full-time during agreed U.S. business hours

• Reliable computer, high-speed internet, and a suitable home workspace



Compensation: PHP 45,000 per month



If you bring strong accounting knowledge, communicate clearly, and take pride in maintaining accurate books and resolving outstanding issues, we would like to hear from you.

About the Opportunity



We are seeking an experienced Senior Architectural Technical Designer to support a boutique U.S.-based interior design firm specializing in high-end finishes, customized spaces, and luxury residential interiors.

Strong residential architectural drafting background

Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD

Strong working experience with Revit, SketchUp, Adobe Photoshop, and 3D rendering software

Experience producing professional U.S. residential construction-document packages

PHP 70,000/month starting salary

A brief description of your experience supporting U.S.-based architectural or interior design firms

Applications without relevant U.S. residential experience, a technical portfolio, and a voice or video introduction will not be considered.

description:
About us

At Enjoy Travel Group, we provide online travel content and booking solutions across a diverse portfolio of brands and products. Our commitment to innovation and adaptability has helped us invest in and grow a range of related brands, technologies and services.

The opportunity

Pricing is central to our success in the car hire market. Prices change constantly across destinations, travel dates and rental providers, so we need accurate, up-to-date information to understand how our prices compare.



We’re looking for a reliable, detail-focused person to support our commercial team. The role is primarily hands-on: checking prices across online travel and comparison platforms, comparing offers from a range of rental companies, and recording the results accurately. It involves regular, repetitive checks and data entry, often across many destinations and travel dates. Consistency and accuracy are essential.



Your responsibilities will include:

- Carrying out regular price checks across online travel and comparison platforms.

- Comparing offers from a range of rental companies across different destinations and travel dates.

- Recording competitor prices and benchmarks accurately.

- Entering and maintaining pricing data in our database for different products, suppliers and travel periods.

- Flagging significant price differences and potential gaps in our pricing.

- Supporting the team with regular pricing reports and data checks.

About you

You’ll bring:

- Strong numeracy and excellent data-processing skills.

- A high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

- Excellent Excel skills.

- Good written and spoken English.

- A motivated, dependable approach and the ability to work through repetitive tasks consistently.

- Experience in data entry, reporting, pricing or data analysis.

It would also be useful to have:

- Reporting experience, ideally with Power BI or a similar tool.

- A basic understanding of databases.

- An interest in mathematics and statistics.

- Knowledge of SQL or a programming language.

- A practical, problem-solving mindset and an interest in helping improve business performance.

title: Guest Services Specialist (Property Management)
description:
Key Responsibilities:



Step One: Listen & Clarify



Read the full conversation and reservation history before responding. Every message should reflect what the guest has already told us. Never make a guest repeat themselves.

Listen for the real issue on live calls, not just the first thing mentioned. Guests under stress don't always lead with what's actually wrong.

Acknowledge the guest clearly and set expectations for what happens next, even when the resolution takes a few more steps.

Correct triage urgency: Tell a true emergency (risk to guest safety or the property) apart from an urgent-but-routine issue and from something that can be logged for the morning and handle each per the client's specific policy.

Step Two: Act & Resolve



Resolve booking questions, complaints, maintenance issues, and general inquiries in real time, following each client's specific policies and procedures.

Make outbound calls to guests, property managers, and vendors to follow up on open issues and confirm resolutions. Don't wait for the guest to have to chase us.

Assist with booking, confirming, and modifying reservations over the phone, including reservation sales support.

Escalate true emergencies and guest-safety issues immediately, following the client's established protocol. No delay, no exceptions.

Coordinate with property managers and internal operations teams during/immediately following live calls to resolve complex situations.

Own every message you send. AI-assisted drafts are a starting point, not a final answer. Review them for accuracy and context before they reach a guest.

Log accurate call notes and dispositions in real time while maintaining full attention on the guest.

Rinse and Repeat



Flag recurring guest issues and process gaps to the team. Every pattern you catch helps us fix something before it hits the next guest.

Attend brief daily huddles and weekly team check-ins.

Qualifications and Requirements: 



Composed and Empathetic Under Pressure: Able to stay calm, empathetic, and solution-oriented on difficult or high-pressure calls. This matters more than almost anything else in this role.

Strong Sense of Responsibility: Demonstrates accountability, reliability, ownership, and follow-through on guest concerns from start to finish.

Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, professional and effective with guests, teammates, and partners.

Accurate and Fast Note-Taker: Able to log call details in real time without losing focus on the guest.

Guesty & Breezeway Proficient: Experience using Guesty and Breezeway (BW) for reservation management, guest communication, task coordination, and property operations. Additional PMS experience is a plus.

Short-Term Rental Experience: Previous experience in short-term rental, vacation rental, hospitality, or guest services is highly preferred.

OTA Background: Required to support a smoother onboarding process. Experience within the last 6 months is preferred; experience older than 2 years will not be considered.

Tech-Savvy: Able to learn new software quickly and navigate multiple systems efficiently. You'll be using PMS and communication tools from day one.

Schedule Flexibility: Willing to work varying schedules based on business needs, including weekends, holidays, and overtime when required.

Location: Must be located within Metro Manila or Cebu, Philippines

Workspace: Stable internet connection and a quiet, dedicated workspace suitable for live calls 24/7.

Physically capable of performing the role and maintaining consistent attendance.

title: Amazon Ads Specialist / PPC Manager

description:
Join a fast-growing team and talk by phone with people who have already bought from APE BORN, helping them get real value from what they bought. Inbound only, no cold calling. Full-time, with a fixed schedule, weekly coaching and room to grow into different kinds of sales work.



Type: Full-time, remote

Shift: 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Eastern time

Pay: $1,000 USD base plus commissions

Start: Flexible start date

How to apply: Resume, a 2-minute voice or video intro, and three short written answers



ABOUT APE BORN AND THIS ROLE

APE BORN sells fitness equipment, coaching, and Elite memberships with coaching to adults who want an easier way back into movement. Many are 50 or older, dealing with sore knees, backs or weight, and have been burned by subscriptions before.



This is an inbound role: you only talk with customers who have already bought from us, and you never cold call. Most of them buy their equipment, then never start. You will be the person who changes that. You will talk with customers at different moments: when they are new, when they have questions, when they are unsure whether to continue, and when they are ready for more coaching. Every customer you help is recurring revenue for the company and a person who finally gets results.



APE BORN moves fast. We are growing, testing new ideas and shifting priorities as we learn, so the work will change over time. In return you get a clear schedule, a coach who reviews your calls every week, and a steady flow of customers to talk to. We place you where the team needs help most and move you based on how you do.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Talk with customers by phone about what they need: getting started with their equipment and membership, questions, concerns about charges, or whether to continue.

- Find out what is really going on before you offer anything. They may not have started, may feel charged unfairly, may have a problem with their equipment, or may just have been busy.

- Explain price, renewal and how to cancel clearly and honestly, every time, before asking for a yes.

- Help customers take their next step, for example logging in and joining the community, booking a coaching consultation, or agreeing on the right time to follow up.

- Call back people you promised to call back, and log every call accurately in our system.

- Review your own calls with your coach each week and change what you do based on the feedback.

- Take on new work as the team grows. You may handle new-customer onboarding, cancellations and revives, or coaching consultation calls.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We care more about how you talk to people than about past sales titles. You do not need sales experience, but you need these:

- Curious about people. You ask questions first and use the answers. You want to know why someone is hesitating.

- Patient. You can stay calm and slow down with an older customer who is stressed, hard of hearing, or learning new technology.

- A helper, not a closer. You see yourself as the customer's person, and you fix their real problem before you talk about the offer.

- Straight about money. You can say the price, the renewal date and how to cancel without hesitating or rounding.

- Coachable. You take feedback, change one thing the next day, and like seeing the result.

- Good judgment. You can tell in the first minute whether a customer needs help, time, or a polite goodbye.

- Reliable. Fixed start time, every scheduled day, and you call back when you said you would.



You also need clear spoken English, a quiet workspace, a computer, and a stable internet connection with a backup. You should also enjoy a fast pace and be able to switch tasks when priorities change.



This is not the role for you if you would say something untrue to get past an objection, you talk over someone who shares something painful, or you see feedback as an argument to win.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Send your resume and a 2-minute voice or video intro as a Google Drive link (set to "Anyone with the link can view"). Tell us who you are and why you want to talk to customers all day.

2. Answer these three questions in a few sentences each:

   - A customer tells you, "I've been busy and haven't had a chance to try it. Maybe this isn't for me." What do you say first, and why?

   - Describe a time someone gave you feedback. What did you change afterward, and what happened?

   - A customer asks, "Is this really free? What happens if I forget to cancel?" Write exactly what you would say.

3. We review every application against the same checklist and reply to everyone.

4. Shortlisted candidates take a 15-minute call, including a short role play of a customer call.

5. Final candidates start working on real calls, where we listen and give feedback after each one.



Please apply with all three parts. Applications without the intro and the written answers will not be reviewed.



PAY, SCHEDULE AND WHERE THIS GOES

- Pay: $1,000 USD base plus commissions.

- Schedule: Full-time, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Eastern time.

- Growth: we start you on the call type where the team needs help most, then move you across onboarding, cancellations and revives, and coaching consultations, and eventually into coaching or training new team members. Moves are based on your call results and your feedback follow-through.

title: Senior AI Video Ad Creator – Meta Ads Direct Response (100% AI-Generated) – Full Time
description:
Senior AI Video Ad Creator – Meta Ads Direct Response (100% AI-Generated) – Full Time



We're a fast-growing DTC brand selling a multifunctional bag, and we're expanding our creative team. We're looking for an editor who has mastered AI video tools and can turn a script into high-converting Meta ads every day, fully AI-generated: B-roll, voiceover, music and sound effects.



This is a real editing job, not a "learn AI on the job" role. Almost everything we ship is AI-generated: AI avatars, AI voiceovers, AI B-roll and AI product motion. You'll receive a script, and you're expected to deliver an ad that holds attention from the first second to the last frame and converts.



All AI tools are provided and paid for by us. You never pay for a credit.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Turn scripts from our creative strategist into finished ads, 6 days a week (15 sec to 1 min each), with multiple hook variations per ad

- Use Claude to break scripts into shot lists and write consistent image/video prompts

- Generate scenes, voices, music and sound effects with Higgsfield and Kie.ai

- Create a range of AI ad styles: cinematic mini-movies, AI drama, 3D animation, paper cutout, cartoon, UGC-style mini VSLs, with the same characters staying consistent from scene to scene

- Keep our product 100% accurate in every shot (built from our real product photos: the bag must look exactly like the real one)

- Manage your tasks and deliveries in ClickUp



PAY

- Starting retainer: $1,000–$3,000/month, based on your experience and your paid test result

- Clear KPIs (output, quality, ad performance), with raises when they're hit

- Bonus for every winning ad (an ad that scales profitably)

- Long-term, stable work for the right person



SCHEDULE

- Full time, 8 hours/day, 6 days/week

- At least 4 hours of overlap with Central European Time (CET)



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Proven experience creating AI video (realistic or animated), ideally ads or story-driven content

- Strong character AND product consistency across scenes

- Direct response understanding: hooks, pacing, CTAs, what makes people stop scrolling and buy

- Daily use of Claude (or a similar AI assistant) in your workflow

- Fast replies during working hours: our team replies within minutes, not hours

- Finished work: accurate captions, smooth pacing, nothing left for us to fix

- A proper setup: desk, reliable computer, stable internet with backup, and a camera for calls

- Fluent written and spoken English



HIRING PROCESS

1. Application review

2. Paid test (2 parts, delivered within 8 hours):

   Part 1 – Script to ad : You'll receive one of our scripts. Turn it into a finished, high-converting ad (100% AI-generated, with voiceover, captions and music) + 3 hook variations.

   Part 2 – Ad recreation : You'll receive a reference ad. Recreate it for our product: keep the structure, pacing and style that make it work, but adapt the visuals, characters and message to our bag.

3. 30-minute video call (including a live screen-share of your workflow)

4. 30-day paid trial period



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word "MULTIBAG" (applications without it won't be read)

2. Share links to 3 AI video ads or direct response ads you made (make sure the links are public)

3. Explain in 2–3 sentences how you keep a product looking identical across AI-generated shots

4. How long have you been creating AI video?

5. Which AI tools do you use for video, voice and music?

6. How many clients do you currently work with, and could you commit full time?

7. Optional but highly appreciated: a 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself



PLEASE NOTE

This role is for experienced AI video creators only. If you're new to editing or AI video, or not fluent in English, this position won't be the right fit. We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term, keep learning, and adapt quickly as AI tools evolve.

title: General Admin & Dispatch Virtual Assistant (Electrical, ServiceM8)
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with hands-on ServiceM8 scheduling and dispatch experience, clear spoken English and strong listening comprehension will be prioritised for this role.



An Australian electrical services business needs a full-time General Admin and Dispatch VA to run the front end of a busy, reactive service operation: phones, inbox and the ServiceM8 schedule for 5 to 7 crews. The challenge is keeping control of a moving machine, with emergency jobs, calls and
s landing at once and the schedule changing through the day, while building real rapport with customers and technicians from outside an open-plan office where decisions are often made out loud.



The non-negotiables are hands-on ServiceM8 scheduling and dispatch experience, clear spoken English with strong listening comprehension, and a task creator rather than a task ticker. Success looks like a VA who is on the phones within the first week in a supported role, independently managing the schedule within 30 to 60 days, keeping records accurate with nothing left half-finished, and freeing the business owner from having to think about the phones, inbox or schedule.



What You'll Own



Scheduling & Dispatch (ServiceM8)



Independently manage daily schedules for 5 to 7 crews

Allocate jobs based on tech capability, job duration, location and travel time

Create new jobs in ServiceM8 with complete, accurate job details

Update existing jobs as details, timing or status change

Slot urgent and emergency bookings into the day and rework the schedule around them

Process cancellations, delays and reschedules as they happen

Keep job statuses current so the office and field team work from the same information

Learn each technician's strengths and which apprentices they're paired with

Over time, make day-to-day scheduling calls without waiting for sign-off, note the reasoning, and flag anything genuinely unusual



Phones (approx. 15-25 inbound calls per day)



Day 1/Week 1 starting task: listen to previous recorded calls to learn the business, common issues, and how the team handles customers

Answer inbound calls from customers and capture job details: name, address, contact number, access notes and fault description

Repeat back key details before ending every call

Identify emergency calls (e.g. no power, safety risk) and get a tech allocated immediately

Log every call outcome in ServiceM8



Inbox Management (approx. 20
s per day)



Day 1/Week 1 starting task: review the last 2-3 months of
 history across the admin inbox and the ServiceM8 inbox to learn how things are typically resolved

Clear the inbox first thing every morning

Manage all inbound channels: the general admin inbox, the ServiceM8 inbox, and system notifications

Action routine
s directly (booking requests, job updates, follow-ups)

Flag anything needing input with a short summary and a suggested next step

Get the inbox to zero, or as close as possible, by end of day



Customer & Technician Communication



Keep customers informed of bookings, arrival times, delays and changes

Keep technicians informed of schedule changes, new urgent jobs and job details

Follow through on every outstanding enquiry until it's closed



Team & Management Liaison



Work with the management team to keep day-to-day operations running smoothly

Raise scheduling conflicts, capacity issues and recurring problems early

Share what you're seeing in the schedule: bottlenecks, repeat callbacks, overloaded crews

When phones and inbox are under control, find the next useful task



Systems & Documentation



Record every training and handover session

Write an SOP for each task after training, then walk it through with the team to confirm it's the right process

Track ad hoc tasks: job-related ones tied to the job in ServiceM8, everything else in Google Tasks



Daily Communication



Morning message with the day's priorities

End-of-day
 report: tasks completed, work in progress, and items needing review, approval or attention



Out of Scope (Current)



Pricing

Invoicing, quoting, bookkeeping and payroll (handled by the business's accountant)



What We're Looking For



Experience



Hands-on ServiceM8 experience, particularly scheduling and dispatch (top priority)

Prior admin or dispatch experience in a service-based trades business, with electrical a strong bonus

Experience in a reactive environment with emergency or same-day work is a nice-to-have



Communication Skills



Clear, confident spoken English for daily calls with Australian customers (top priority)

Strong listening comprehension, including with customers who have strong accents or speak English as a second language

A warm, relaxed phone manner that builds rapport with clients and the field team

Habit of repeating back details and asking again rather than guessing

Comfortable saying "I'll find out and call you back" and following through



Technical Proficiency



ServiceM8: scheduling, dispatch, job creation, inbox, tasks, phone system

Gmail and Google Workspace (Gmail, Tasks, Meet, Chat)

WhatsApp

Willing to learn tools like Fathom quickly

Comfortable working across two screens with the full schedule displayed



Organisational Skills



Keeps control of a schedule that changes through the day

Prioritises well when urgent jobs, calls and
s land at once

Strong attention to detail on bookings, job notes and admin

Closes the loop: accurate records, nothing half-finished, nothing left sitting



Non-Negotiables



Task creator, not a task ticker — finds the next useful thing to do once urgent work is done

Flags when there isn't enough on and suggests work rather than waiting

Documents processes without being prompted

Comfortable making scheduling decisions and owning the outcome

Easygoing and approachable, with a personality fit that suits a relaxed, direct team culture — avoid overly formal, passive or deferential candidates

Access to dual monitors (a local purchase can be arranged if needed)



Working Arrangements



Full-time role, replacing an existing in-house position

Hands-on training sequence: an intro day, a "sit with me" day watching live operations, listening to recorded calls and reviewing inbox history, then a supported period answering calls

Likely joins an all-day virtual office (Google Meet) given the business's open-plan, d
-out-loud culture



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of the front end of a busy, reactive service business

Real autonomy to make scheduling decisions, not just execute instructions

Join a tight-knit, easygoing team that values rapport and straight talk over formality

A business actively looking to build out VA support further, with room to grow into more as trust is established



How to Apply



To be considered, please complete this form and include a short video introduction — ideally one that clearly demonstrates spoken English and listening comprehension.

title: SaaS Software Researcher & Tech Review Writer
description:
We are a growing UK-based digital publishing company building an extensive library of software reviews, pricing guides and product comparisons.



We're looking for an experienced software researcher and technology writer who can independently investigate software products and produce accurate, insightful and genuinely useful articles.



This is not a generic AI content-writing position. Genuine research and an understanding of the software are essential.



What You'll Be Doing



- Each month, we aim to cover approximately 15 to 20 software products, producing three articles for each:



- Software Reviews: Detailed, balanced assessments of features, usability, strengths, weaknesses and the type of customer best suited to the product.



- Pricing Guides: Accurate explanations of subscription plans, costs, limitations, discounts and value for money.



- Alternatives Articles: Research-backed comparisons with competing products, explaining where each option performs better or worse.



We have established content structures and workflows, but we want someone who can bring genuine expertise, judgment and originality to the writing.



Our Research Expectations



This is the most important part of the role.



When researching software, we expect you to:



- Sign up for free trials or free plans wherever available.



- Explore the actual software, its interface, settings and features.



- Take relevant screenshots and document what you discover.



- Where trials aren't available, watch detailed YouTube tutorials and product walkthroughs showing how the software actually works.



- Research official documentation, pricing pages, knowledge bases and release notes.



- Cross-check information against independent reviews, user feedback and relevant competitors.



- Identify genuine advantages, limitations, usability issues and customer complaints.



- Verify factual information, especially pricing, features and subscription terms.



- You must distinguish between software you've personally tested and software you've researched through demonstrations or other sources.



- We do not want articles that simply repeat the manufacturer's website or paraphrase existing reviews.



Writing Requirements



We need someone who writes like a knowledgeable technology journalist, not an AI content generator.



Your writing should be:



- Natural, fluent and engaging, with excellent English.



- Well researched, factual and informative.



- Balanced, including honest criticism where appropriate.



- SEO-aware without awkward keyword stuffing.



- Useful to someone genuinely d
 whether to purchase a subscription.



- Original in its analysis, conclusions and comparisons.



We use AI tools to improve efficiency and support research and editing. You're welcome to use them intelligently, but lightly edited AI-generated articles are not acceptable. These must be written by yourself, and will be checked extensively. 



Preferred Experience



- Previous experience writing SaaS or technology reviews.



- Familiarity with software categories such as AI tools, SEO, marketing, design, productivity, hosting and business software.



- Experience with SEO content creation.



- WordPress knowledge.



- Ability to create comparison tables, FAQs and well-structured articles.



- Strong independent research and fact-checking skills.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your own words. Generic applications will not be considered.



1) Provide links to two software or technology articles you personally researched and wrote. Explain exactly what you contributed.



2) Tell us about a software product you've personally tested. What did you discover that wouldn't be obvious from reading its website?



3) If you were asked to review a software product with no free trial, how would you research it thoroughly?



4) Explain how you currently use AI tools in your research and writing workflow.



5) Have you written software comparisons, pricing guides or detailed SaaS reviews before? Please provide examples.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a practical assignment involving software research and writing.



We're looking for someone dependable who takes pride in their research and can consistently produce high-quality work.



Please do not use AI in your application. It will be noticed.

title: YouTube Software Review Video Creator | Screen Recording, AI Voiceover & Editing

title: LLM Integration & Automation Engineer
description:
**Full-Time | Remote Philippines | Australian Engineering Consultancy**



### About the Company



Inhouse Consulting Engineers (ICE) is an established Australian structural and civil engineering consultancy.



We are seeking an experienced AI Automation & LLM Integration Specialist to design (or identify applications), develop and deploy AI-powered business applications and automated workflows.



The successful candidate will have practical experience integrating large language models (such as OpenAI and Claude), developing AI agents, processing and analysing documents, and connecting business applications through APIs and automation platforms.



Strong programming capability in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript or similar languages is highly desirable. We are particularly interested in candidates who can independently deliver complete, reliable AI automation solutions rather than simply configure chatbots or use AI prompting tools.



Our objective is to automate repetitive processes involving quotations, technical engineering documents, SOPs, workflows, project coordination, quality assurance and management reporting.



**This is a hands-on applied AI integration and automation role, focused on using existing AI models, APIs and software technologies to develop practical solutions to real business problems. The role involves designing, building, integrating and deploying AI-powered workflows and applications, rather than training AI models or conducting AI research.**



### What You Will Be Doing



**1. AI Document Processing & Quality Assurance**



- Develop AI applications that read, extract and interpret information from PDF documents, drawings, technical reports and spreadsheets.

- Build systems that compare documents against predefined requirements and checklists.

- Identify missing information, inconsistencies and deviations from approved procedures.

- Generate structured QA reports with references to the relevant source documents.

- Implement validation processes and human approval checkpoints.



**2. AI-Powered Quotation and Project Automation**



- Develop AI workflows that analyse incoming client enquiries and supporting documentation.

- Automate preparation of draft quotations using our templates, fee structures and business rules.

- Build AI systems that generate standardised project methodologies and work instructions from approved company procedures.

- Automate document handling, project initiation, approvals and workflow coordination.



**3. LLM Integration & AI Agents**



- Integrate LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Claude and other suitable models into business applications.

- Develop RAG systems using our internal documents and company knowledge.

- Build AI agents and automated workflows capable of completing multi-step business processes.

- Develop reliable structured outputs, error handling, logging and monitoring.

- Improve AI accuracy through testing, evaluation and validation.



**4. Software Integration & Business Automation**



- Integrate Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Harvest and Excel-based project registers.

- Build REST API integrations, webhooks and background automation services.

- Develop notifications, dashboards and reporting tools for project progress, staff activity and budget monitoring.

- Identify and implement additional opportunities to improve efficiency using Python and AI.



### Essential Skills



- 3–6 years of commercial software development or integration experience.

- At least 12–24 months building LLM-enabled applications or AI automation systems.

- Experience integrating LLM APIs, including OpenAI, Claude or equivalent.

- Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks and backend development.

- Experience processing PDFs, documents and structured data.

- Understanding of RAG, embeddings and AI document retrieval.

- Experience developing, deploying and maintaining working applications.

- Good understanding of databases, Git, testing and debugging.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Strong coding with Python or similar

- Ability to work independently, solve problems and communicate progress clearly.



### Highly Desirable



- FastAPI, Flask or Node.js.

- LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or similar frameworks.

- n8n or Microsoft Power Automate.

- Multimodal AI, OCR and document intelligence.

- Azure, Microsoft Graph API and SharePoint integrations.

- PDF and Excel automation using Python.

- Docker, cloud deployment and application security.

- Experience developing AI solutions for document-intensive businesses.



A degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, IT or a related discipline is preferred.



**Structural and civil engineering experience or knowledge is NOT required.** You will work with our qualified engineers, who remain responsible for technical design, verification and certification.



### What Makes This Role Different?

title: SEO Link Builder
description:
We are a digital marketing agency looking for an experienced **SEO Link Builder** to join our team and help execute link-building campaigns across multiple client accounts.



We are looking for someone who understands that successful link building is about **quality, relevance, authority, and strategy — not simply generating a high volume of backlinks.**



## Responsibilities



- Research and identify high-quality backlink opportunities for client websites

- Prospect relevant websites, publications, blogs, and industry-specific resources

- Conduct outreach to website owners, editors, publishers, and contributors

- Secure guest posts, editorial links, niche placements, resource links, and other legitimate backlink opportunities

- Evaluate websites before placement using metrics such as:

  - Domain Rating / Domain Authority

  - Organic traffic

  - Traffic trends

  - Topical relevance

  - Spam signals

  - Link profile quality

- Use tools such as **Ahrefs, Semrush, and/or similar SEO platforms** to evaluate backlink opportunities

- Build links to both primary service pages and important internal pages — not only the homepage

- Follow provided keyword and anchor-text strategies

- Maintain natural anchor-text diversity

- Research competitor backlink profiles to identify new opportunities

- Communicate with publishers regarding pricing, requirements, edits, and placement

- Verify that backlinks are live, indexed, and placed correctly

- Maintain organized records of outreach, costs, placements, anchor text, destination URLs, and live links

- Monitor previously acquired backlinks and flag lost or removed links

- Work with our SEO and project management team to meet monthly client link-building goals

- Provide proof of completed work and updates on campaigns



## What We Are Looking For



- Previous hands-on experience with **SEO link building**

- Strong understanding of off-page SEO and backlink strategy

- Experience evaluating the quality of websites before securing placements

- Familiarity with Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search, and Google Sheets

- Strong internet research and prospecting skills

- Experience with blogger/publisher outreach

- Ability to identify spammy, low-quality, or potentially harmful websites

- Understanding of anchor-text diversification and contextual linking

- Strong written English and professional communication skills

- Highly organized and able to manage multiple client campaigns at once

- Ability to work independently while following established SEO processes



## Important



We are **not looking for someone who only submits websites to directories, profile sites, or automated backlink services.**



Candidates should understand how to find and secure legitimate, relevant backlinks from websites with real organic traffic and strong authority.



We do **not** want spammy link farms, PBNs, mass-generated backlinks, or placements on websites created solely for selling links.



## Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



- Guest-post outreach

- Digital PR / editorial placements

- Competitor backlink gap research

- Local SEO link building

- Agency SEO

- Working with multiple client websites

- Negotiating publisher placement costs

- Tracking link-building campaigns and budgets



## To Apply



Please send:



1. A short summary of your SEO/link-building experience

2. How many years you have been building backlinks

3. The SEO tools you regularly use

4. Examples of backlinks or placements you have successfully secured

5. A brief explanation of how you determine whether a website is a **good backlink opportunity**

6. Your availability and desired rate



**Please do not send a generic application. We are specifically looking for someone with hands-on link-building experience.**

=========================================================================================



JOB DESCRIPTION



We are an established international company seeking a highly professional, reliable and experienced Sales & Business Development Assistant to support our operations in the United Arab Emirates. We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded individual who is confident communicating with corporate clients, managing administrative responsibilities and developing new business opportunities.



The successful candidate will be responsible for managing business
s, conducting outbound sales calls, researching prospective clients, generating leads, scheduling appointments and following up with potential customers. Additional responsibilities include maintaining CRM records, preparing professional correspondence, organising schedules and providing daily reports on completed activities and sales progress.



A key responsibility of this position is attending face-to-face meetings with prospective clients across the UAE. You must be confident representing the company independently, communicating with senior decision-makers, presenting business services professionally and building strong client relationships. Although most administrative duties will be performed remotely, attending physical business meetings is mandatory.



We require candidates with previous experience in B2B sales, business development, administration, client relationship management or similar professional roles. Applicants must possess excellent written and spoken English, strong telephone communication skills, commercial awareness and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities efficiently. Experience using CRM systems, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace and other business software is highly desirable.



The ideal candidate will be organised, self-motivated, punctual and capable of working independently without constant supervision. Professionalism, confidentiality, integrity, attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions accurately are essential.



-===================================================================================================



MIN 25 APPLY POINT REQUIRED 



HOW TO APPLY – ANSWER ALL 7 QUESTIONS



All applicants must provide detailed answers to the following questions. Generic applications, incomplete responses and applications that do not meet our requirements will not be shortlisted.



UAE LOCATION & VISA STATUS

CURRENT EMPLOYMENT & AGE

PROFESSIONAL WORK EXPERIENCE

SKILLS & TASKS YOU CAN PERFORM



What specific tasks can you confidently perform independently without additional training? Please explain your experience with business
 management, outbound sales calls, lead generation, client research, appointment scheduling, client follow-ups, administrative support and daily reporting.

title: Power BI Virtual Assistant

Strong understanding of data processing, validation, and integration

Experience using API connections to build integrations between software

Please include the word wizard in your subject line when applying if reading this

Application Requirement:

Applicants must submit a 2–3 minute video recording (or video link) speaking in English, which may be a brief introduction or a short sample conversation highlighting relevant experience and skills. Applications submitted without a video will not be considered. Applicants must also submit a resume or portfolio and a brief cover message. Incomplete applications or applications that do not follow instructions will not be considered.



Why Native Pest Management:

At Native Pest Management, we focus on creating long-term careers for our employees with clear paths for growth. Our goal is to become the largest privately held pest control company in Florida, which will continue to open doors for advancement.

With over 10,000 five-star reviews across platforms like Google, Yelp, and Angie’s List, our team takes pride in delivering exceptional service that keeps customers coming back and referring us to others. That reputation is a direct reflection of the hard work and professionalism of our staff.

We are committed to providing valuable, comprehensive, and affordable benefits to our employees. Each year, we review our programs to ensure they continue to meet these goals and support our team’s evolving needs. We’re committed to your success now and in the future.



This role requires exceptional English language proficiency, with precise pronunciation and highly effective conversational skills, to ensure clear, confident, and professional communication with team members.



What to Expect During the Hiring Process:

Native Pest Management is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Logistics and QA coordinator
description:
Remote | Philippines based | Australian company



Raven Engineering Group specialises in water storage tanks, engineering, installation, refurbishment and maintenance projects across Australia.



We're looking for a highly organised logistics and quality assurance coordinator with exceptional attention to detail, strong communication skills and the ability to take ownership of tasks from start to finish.



Your main responsibility will be making sure our projects are properly prepared, materials arrive correctly and on time, and all required QA documentation is completed, checked and filed.



We need someone who is proactive, works efficiently and identifies problems before they cause delays or additional costs.



This is not simply an administrative role. We want someone who takes responsibility for keeping things organised, following up outstanding items and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Key responsibilities



Logistics and material coordination



• Coordinate material orders, supplier deliveries, freight and equipment movements across our Australian projects.



• Review purchase orders, drawings, specifications and material lists to confirm the correct items and quantities have been ordered.



• Track supplier manufacturing progress, dispatch dates, delivery schedules and outstanding components.



• Coordinate with suppliers and freight providers to confirm packing lists, shipment details, dimensions, weights and delivery requirements.



• Arrange freight consolidation where materials from multiple suppliers need to be combined into a single delivery.



• Coordinate receiving inspections with suppliers and logistics partners to verify materials against approved lists before dispatch.



• Obtain packing photos, delivery records and supporting documentation to confirm materials are complete and correctly identified.



• Identify shortages, incorrect components, damaged materials and delivery discrepancies. Follow through until resolved.



• Coordinate movement of tools, lifting equipment and other company assets between projects.



• Confirm site delivery requirements, including access, unloading equipment, delivery contacts and any restrictions.



• Maintain accurate records of material orders, deliveries, equipment movements and outstanding items.



Quality assurance and document control



• Maintain accurate QA records for projects from initial procurement through to completion.



• Prepare, review and track inspection and test plans (ITPs), QA checklists, material certificates and supporting documentation.



• Check documentation for completeness, consistency and correct project details before submitting it for technical approval.



• Review inspection photographs, site records and supporting evidence to confirm that required documentation has been provided.



• Identify missing signatures, incomplete inspection records, incorrect document revisions and conflicting information.



• Coordinate with suppliers, engineers, site supervisors and subcontractors to obtain outstanding QA documentation.



• Maintain defect registers, nonconformance records and rectification action lists.



• Track outstanding defects and corrective actions until the responsible person confirms completion.



• Ensure current approved drawings, procedures and specifications are available to the relevant team members.



• Coordinate completion reports, inspection reports, warranty documentation and final handover packages.



• Maintain organised project folders and document registers so records can be located easily.



Technical and engineering approvals remain the responsibility of the appropriate qualified personnel. Your role is to make sure the information is complete, accurate and ready for review.



Project preparation and operational support



• Review upcoming projects and identify outstanding requirements before mobilisation.



• Confirm required materials, equipment, tools and documentation are ready before work is scheduled to begin.



• Coordinate site access requirements, inductions, licences, certificates and other necessary approvals.



• Work with our operations team to confirm site readiness and any outstanding client responsibilities.



• Track installation schedules, supplier commitments and delivery deadlines.



• Identify potential delays early and communicate them clearly to the relevant team members.



• Follow up with site supervisors to obtain daily records, photographs, completed checklists and outstanding QA evidence.



• Keep project status, outstanding actions and key dates updated in our management systems.



• Support the operations and accounts teams by identifying outstanding documentation or approvals that may delay project milestones and payments.



• Ensure projects have a clear record of outstanding items and responsibilities through to final completion.



Communication and attention to detail



Strong communication is essential. You'll be dealing with our Australian team, suppliers, transport companies, engineers and clients.



We expect someone who can communicate clearly, ask precise questions and follow through without constant reminders.



• Read relevant
s, drawings and supporting documents before responding.



• Understand the actual issue before asking questions or requesting further information.



• Write clear, natural and professional
s.



• Be confident making phone calls when they will resolve an issue faster than
.



• Confirm important details rather than making assumptions.



• Check job numbers, drawings, quantities, specifications, delivery addresses and attachments before sending.



• Keep the right people informed when something changes or requires attention.



• Take ownership of outstanding tasks until they are resolved or properly handed over.



We need someone who can produce accurate work with minimal correction. Being busy is not the same as making progress. We value people who finish what they start.



Improve how we work



We're looking for someone who can improve our logistics and QA processes, not just follow existing procedures.



This includes helping us build and maintain reliable checklists, material registers, QA templates and project tracking systems.



You should be comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools to review documents, organise information, prepare correspondence and reduce repetitive administration.



You must be able to check AI generated information against the original documents and recognise when something requires further review.



We want someone who actively identifies opportunities to reduce errors, avoid unnecessary costs and make our operations more efficient.



What we're looking for



• Experience in logistics coordination, construction administration, quality assurance, document control, procurement or a similar role.



• Experience working with construction, engineering, manufacturing or industrial projects is highly desirable.



• Exceptional attention to detail and consistent accuracy.



• Excellent written and spoken English. You must be articulate, professional and confident communicating with Australian clients and suppliers.



• Strong Excel and spreadsheet skills, including maintaining registers, tracking records and checking data.



• Ability to read and understand technical drawings, material lists, specifications and project documentation.



• Familiarity with QA procedures, ITPs, inspection records and controlled documentation is highly desirable.



• Experience coordinating suppliers, freight, deliveries and project materials.



• Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.



• Confidence using ChatGPT, AI tools and other technology to improve productivity.



• Experience with Pipedrive, ServiceM8, Google Workspace or similar systems would be an advantage.



• Initiative, accountability and consistent follow through.



You should not need repeated reminders to chase suppliers, update records, follow up outstanding documents or complete assigned tasks.



About the role



This is a remote position working with our Australian team during agreed Australian business hours.



We will provide training on our products, systems and internal processes. However, you must already have strong organisational skills, attention to detail and professional communication abilities.



You will work closely with our operations, engineering, procurement and project management teams.



Performance will be measured by:



• Material accuracy and delivery coordination.



• Completeness and accuracy of QA documentation.



• Timely identification and resolution of outstanding issues.



• Reliable project updates and follow through.



• Reduction in avoidable delays, missing materials and documentation errors.



• Clear, responsive communication with the team, suppliers and clients.



There is an opportunity to grow into a broader operations or quality management role as you develop your understanding of the business.



How to apply



Send a one minute introductory video and your CV directly to WhatsApp:




Record and send your video directly in the WhatsApp chat. Only videos playable within the chat will be viewed. Do not send Google Drive links, cloud storage links or links to download your video.



In your video, briefly explain:



• Your experience with logistics, QA, document control or project coordination.



• How you would prevent missing or incorrect materials from being delivered to a construction site.



• How you manage multiple outstanding tasks and ensure nothing gets forgotten.



• One practical example of how you have used AI or automation to improve your work.



Send your CV as an attachment in the same WhatsApp chat. Include your expected monthly salary in USD, earliest start date and availability during Australian business hours.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a practical exercise covering material reconciliation, QA document checking, attention to detail and client communication.



Applications without a video sent directly in WhatsApp will not be considered.

title: Project manager and QA coordinator (Remote)
description:
Remote | Philippines based | Australian company | Immediate start



Raven Engineering Group specialises in water storage tanks, engineering, installation, refurbishment and maintenance projects across Australia.



We’re looking for an organised, confident project manager to take ownership of our projects from sales handover through to completion and final payment.

Progression will depend on results, attention to detail and your ability to manage projects independently and improve how we work.



The position is available to start immediately.



Project management responsibilities



• Manage approximately 40 active projects at different stages, from sales handover through to completion and final payment.

• Maintain accurate project records, tasks, responsibilities and follow ups in Pipedrive and ServiceM8.

• Coordinate engineering, estimating, procurement, installation and accounts.

• Identify delays and problems early. Resolve what you can and escalate decisions with clear facts and proposed next steps.

Quality assurance and project readiness

• Coordinate checks of delivered materials against approved specifications, including product codes, delivery records and certificates.

Technical decisions and engineering certification remain with the responsible qualified people. Site supervisors remain responsible for checking physical materials and workmanship. Your responsibility is to make sure these checks happen, the evidence is recorded and outstanding items are closed.



Improve how we work



We want someone who spots recurring problems and introduces practical improvements.



This includes improving project handovers, material checks, checklists, reporting and document control.



You should be comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools to help review information, prepare reports and identify gaps. You must check the output and know when an issue needs a person with technical expertise.



What we’re looking for



• Proven experience managing multiple projects in construction, engineering, manufacturing or a similar environment.

• Strong attention to detail and consistent follow through.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with confidence speaking to Australian clients, suppliers and site teams.

• Experience coordinating QA records, inspections, material approvals or project closeout.

• Strong organisation and the ability to prioritise a busy workload independently.

• Commercial awareness and confidence tracking budgets, variations and payments.

• Strong Excel skills and confidence using project management systems.

• Pipedrive and ServiceM8 experience is highly desirable.

• Confidence using AI tools while applying your own judgement.



We need someone who takes ownership, raises problems early and follows them through. You should not need constant reminders to complete tasks or chase outstanding actions.

You’ll be the main contact for your team—providing support, training, and clear direction. The role involves guiding members through daily tasks as well as complex closing challenges. We’re looking for a strong communicator who can build a positive, productive remote work environment.



Competitive pay + real promotion opportunities

100% remote | Work with US clients

4 DAYS OF WORK WITH 3 DAYS OFF!



Requirements:

Must have managerial experience 

Proven experience in full-cycle accounting services

Steve Bowles

title: Creative Digital ARTIST
description:
Digital Artist Wanted — Realistic Fantasy Lioness, Jewelled Crown & Flames | US$100



We’re seeking a skilled digital artist to create a signature character for an inspirational brand about courage, inner strength and moving forward.



The vision



A soft, feminine lioness face with the magnificent, flowing mane of a male lion—powerful yet gentle, regal, brave and magical, with realistic feline features rather than a cartoon appearance.



She needs:



A softly shaped face in warm champagne, ivory and gold, with natural shading.



A luxurious, windswept mane and clearly visible ears.



Amber-gold eyes with visible pupils and a fiery glow contained inside the eyes.



An intricate gold crown with elegant branching points, a striking central jewel and sparkling jewel details.



Convincing golden flames and fine fire embers around the crown and outer mane—no paint splashes, glitter effects or shooting stars.



No feathered wings.



Artwork required



Keep the same character, colouring and crown consistent across these views and poses:



Front-facing portrait.



Side-facing portrait.



Lounging on a textured black-and-gold rock, with her head resting sideways on her paws.



Standing tall, with her full body and tail visible.



Prancing towards the viewer while roaring.



Rear view, as though walking away.



Provide matching versions with and without flames. Supply the lion, crown, flames/embers and rock as separate reusable elements, as well as complete compositions, so we can reposition them or use them independently.



Files and references



High-resolution JPGs and transparent PNGs.



Black-background versions with generous space around every complete pose; no cropped crown, mane, paws or tail.



Editable, layered source files with the reusable elements separated.



A simple front, side and back character reference sheet.



Separate front and side crown references showing its structure and jewel placement.



Two rounds of revisions.



The lion will eventually become a stuffed toy, and the crown a glistening, bejewelled wearable crown. Designs must be clear enough for future makers to interpret. Physical production, sewing patterns and engineering are outside this job.



Animation — additional quote



We also want a short animation of this same lion roaring. Please quote separately, state whether sound is included, and provide relevant animation samples. Further animation may be negotiated.



Private references



We have an existing reference image, but substantial changes are required. We will privately share the image, brand identity and detailed changes with a shortlisted artist after initial agreement on price and requirements. Review these and confirm the full scope before starting. Keep all supplied material confidential.



Ownership



Upon full payment, you must agree in writing to assign all transferable intellectual property rights in your original contributions to us, worldwide for their full duration, including commercial use, modification, reproduction, licensing and product manufacture, without further fees or royalties.



Disclose any AI, stock or third-party materials and restrictions before starting. Do not use anything that prevents the agreed ownership or uses. No resale, reuse, sharing or portfolio publication of our references or completed designs without written permission. Any reference permissions must be resolved before work begins.



Budget: US$100 total for the static artwork



Includes all listed static artwork, files and two revision rounds. Animation is separately negotiated. Flag scope concerns upfront; no additional charges without written agreement.



To apply, include:



Your portfolio link and three relevant existing samples—not only logos—showing realistic animals, fur, fantasy artwork, crowns/jewellery or flames. Explain your contribution.



A brief approach, tools used and whether you use AI.



Turnaround time and proposed final image dimensions.



Confirmation that you accept the static-artwork scope, US$100 budget, revisions, confidentiality and ownership terms.



A separate animation quote, if offered.



Existing samples are sufficient; no unpaid custom sample is required.

title: GSA Government Contracting & Procurement Specialist
description:
Mandatory Application Form

This form is the only application method we will accept. We will only review applications submitted through this form. Applications sent through OLJ messages,
, or other channels will not be considered.



Please answer all questions thoroughly and provide specific examples of your government contracting experience. Only candidates who meet the qualifications and complete the required form will be considered.



Someone who has already worked for a U.S. government contractor, GSA Schedule holder, or GovCon consulting firm and has helped identify, qualify, or prepare bids for government contracts.

Job Overview



The GSA Government Contracting & Procurement Specialist will support our efforts to identify and pursue federal, state, and local government contracting opportunities.



The ideal candidate has previous experience working with a GSA contractor, navigating 
, researching government solicitations, and supporting bids or proposals. Experience with municipalities and government procurement portals is also highly desirable.



We are particularly interested in someone who understands how government contractors find opportunities, determine eligibility, prepare submissions, and track bids through award decisions.



Key Responsibilities



1. Government Contract Opportunity Research



Search 
 for relevant federal contracting opportunities.



Identify opportunities involving solar installations, renewable energy, battery storage, electrical systems, construction, roofing, and related material supplies.



Research state, county, city, and municipal procurement portals for additional opportunities.



Review solicitations, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Quotes (RFQs), and Invitations for Bids (IFBs).



Maintain a pipeline of potential contracts with deadlines, estimated values, requirements, and next steps.



2. GSA Contract Support



Help identify opportunities available through our existing GSA approval and contract structure.



Research applicable GSA schedules, contract requirements, and purchasing channels.



Review opportunity requirements and flag eligibility, compliance, documentation, or qualification gaps.
