Help determine whether opportunities are a good fit for our capabilities and contract terms.



3. Bid and Proposal Coordination



Track bid deadlines, required documents, submission instructions, and evaluation criteria.



Prepare bid checklists and organize supporting documentation.



Coordinate internally to collect pricing, technical information, project qualifications, and other required materials.



Assist with drafting and assembling bids and proposals for management review.



Monitor submitted bids and track award announcements, clarifications, and follow-up requirements.



4. Government Contracting Platforms and Tools



Research and evaluate platforms such as Cleatus and other government opportunity discovery tools.



Compare available opportunities against our services, qualifications, and business objectives.



Help establish a repeatable process for sourcing, evaluating, and tracking government contracts.



Maintain an organized opportunity tracker or CRM with clear statuses and action items.



5. Reporting and Business Development Support



Provide regular reports on new opportunities, upcoming deadlines, bids submitted, and pending decisions.



Recommend opportunities based on relevance, qualification requirements, potential value, and likelihood of successful execution.



Identify gaps in our current government contracting process and suggest practical improvements.



Help management understand the steps needed to turn our GSA approval into a viable revenue channel.



Required Qualifications



Demonstrated experience supporting government contractors or government procurement activities.



Hands-on experience with 
 and government solicitation research.



Working knowledge of GSA contracting, GSA schedules, or relevant government purchasing processes.



Experience reviewing RFPs, RFQs, IFBs, or similar solicitations.



Strong written English and professional communication skills.



Excellent research, organization, documentation, and follow-through.



Ability to manage multiple opportunities and deadlines independently.



Proficiency with spreadsheets, online research tools, and task management systems.



Preferred Qualifications



Previous work with a GSA contractor or federal government vendor.



Experience identifying opportunities through federal, state, county, and municipal procurement systems.



Experience supporting construction, electrical, solar, renewable energy, battery storage, or roofing contractors.



Familiarity with bid preparation, proposal coordination, government vendor registration, and contract compliance.



Experience with government contracting opportunity discovery platforms, including Cleatus or comparable tools.



Experience building an opportunity pipeline or bid-tracking process from scratch.



What Success Looks Like



In this role, you will help us establish a practical and repeatable government contracting workflow.



Initial priorities include:



Review our existing GSA contracting position and identify the information needed to pursue opportunities.



Identify relevant federal, state, and municipal procurement sources.



Build a targeted pipeline of qualified contracting opportunities.



Establish a tracking system for opportunities, deadlines, bids, and outcomes.



Recommend which opportunities management should prioritize.



Help coordinate bid submissions and follow-ups once opportunities are approved internally.



Performance will be evaluated based on the relevance and quality of opportunities identified, accuracy of tracking, deadline management, quality of bid support, and progress toward building a sustainable government contracting pipeline.

title: Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager
description:
SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER



Salary: $3,500 – $5,000 USD / month (Base) + Aggressive Annual Performance Bonus tied to KPI achievement 

Remote | Full-time | 



*****ABOUT THE ROLE*****



ARE YOU THE SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER WE’RE LOOKING FOR? 🎸⚡️



Intent Brands operates SurviveX (first-aid and preparedness products) and Aerotrunk (luggage). 

Website: 

: 



We are seeking an exceptional, numbers-driven Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager to take

end-to-end commercial and operational ownership of our unified Amazon Seller Central account.



Currently generating approximately $20 million in trailing 12-month revenue, our portfolio consists of two

category-leading brands: one in First Aid & Emergency Preparedness and the other in Travel Accessories.

Both brands operate under a single Seller Central account, presenting significant opportunities for catalog

expansion, advertising efficiency, and cross-merchandising.



In this role, you are not simply managing listings. You are the primary owner of the channel’s P&L. You will

make high-stakes executive decisions backed by financial rigor, driving profitable top-line and bottom-line

expansion. You will orchestrate advertising strategy, listing conversion optimization, promotional calendars,

external traffic capture, and strategic relationships (including our Amazon SAS Core partner).



******** KEY RESPONSIBILITIES********



1. P&L Ownership & Financial Leadership

• Commercial Accountability: Own the Amazon channel P&L end-to-end, steering margin health,

revenue velocity, and net contribution.

• Cost & Margin Decomposition: Deeply analyze unit economics, Landed COGS, Amazon fee

structures (FBA fulfillment, referral, storage, aged inventory surcharges), and overall contribution margin

to inform pricing and operational decisions.

• Capital & TACoS Allocation: Determine and allocate target TACoS (Total Advertising Cost of Sales)

percentage points across specific product lines and ad formats to maintain healthy profitability while

unlocking incremental growth.



2. Advertising Strategy & External Traffic Leverage

• PPC Team Collaboration: Partner closely with our internal PPC Manager to execute high-performing

ad campaigns across all inventory formats:

• Sponsored Products (SP)

• Sponsored Brands (SB)

• Sponsored Brand Video (SBV)

• Sponsored Display (SD)

• TACoS Discipline: Ensure campaign efficiency aligns strictly with overarching P&L margin targets and

inventory lifecycle stages.

• External Traffic & Spillover Synergy: Quantify and leverage halo traffic originating from our

direct-to-consumer (Shopify) marketing channels. Devise strategies to capture, attribute, and accelerate

this external demand to boost Amazon organic rank and BSR velocity.



3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Listing Architecture

• Systematic CRO Audits: Regularly audit existing product detail pages (PDPs) across both brand

catalogs to identify friction points and conversion leakage.

• Hypothesis-Driven Testing: Develop structured CRO hypotheses for creative assets, infographics,

Premium A+ Content, copy, and video.

• Creative Collaboration: Partner with our Creative Designer to produce conversion-optimized creative

assets based on your strategic briefs.

• A/B Experimentation: Design, execute, and monitor iterative A/B tests (via Amazon Manage Your

Experiments and third-party tooling) to systematically identify winning listing iterations that maximize

conversion rate and session value.

• Search Query Performance (SQP) Optimization: Utilize Amazon SQP and Brand Analytics data to

reverse-engineer customer search intent, refining titles, bullet points, backend search terms, and

descriptions for organic dominance.



4. Merchandising, Cross-Selling & Promotional Strategy

• Parent/Child ASIN Architecture: Capitalize on our high-performing cross-selling parent ASIN

structures to maximize basket size, customer lifetime value, and cross-brand discovery.

• Deal Cadence & Execution: Plan, schedule, and execute high-impact promotional events, including

7-Day / Best Deals and Prime Exclusive Deals (PEDs).

• Deal Post-Mortems: Rigorously evaluate every promotional event to assess whether it delivered

genuine incremental velocity while safeguarding net contribution margins.

• Amazon Storefront Optimization: Continuously evaluate Storefront performance and landing page

entry points. Optimize brand narrative, user navigation, and the path to purchase to reduce bounce rates

and maximize average order value (AOV).



5. Technical Operations & Strategic Escalations

• Catalog Health & Compliance: Work in tandem with our Amazon Technical Specialist to proactively

maintain account health, resolve listing suppressions, remediate stranded inventory, and expedite case

resolution.

• Amazon SAS Core Management: Serve as the primary operational and strategic liaison with our

dedicated Amazon SAS Core representative, leveraging this relationship for new beta programs,

commercial growth opportunities, and critical issue escalations.





********CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS********



**Required Experience:**



1.)  High-Volume Track Record: 5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central management, with proven

success steering high-volume, 8-figure accounts ($10M to $20M+ annual run rate).



2.) P&L Fluency: Thorough understanding of e-commerce financial models, contribution margin analysis,

fee structures, and TACoS/ROAS balance.



3.) Advanced Amazon Tooling: Mastery of Amazon Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance (SQP),

Manage Your Experiments, Category Insight reports, and the full Amazon Ads console.



4.) Analytical & Data-Driven: Exceptional analytical capability with advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills;

ability to turn granular marketplace data into decisive commercial action.



5.) Strategic CRO Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing creative briefs, formulating conversion

hypotheses, and executing split-testing protocols.



6.)  Autonomous Leadership: Executive presence and proactive mindset capable of managing

cross-functional contributors (PPC specialists, technical support, creative designers).



**Preferred Qualifications**

1.)  Direct experience in consumer physical products within the Emergency Preparedness / First Aid or

Travel Gear / Accessories categories.

2.)  Familiarity with omni-channel dynamics, specifically the interaction between Shopify D2C advertising

and Amazon organic lift.

3.) Experience managing Amazon SAS Core or equivalent dedicated account management programs.



********HOW TO APPLY********

To apply, please submit:



1.) Links to your Updated Resume  & Portfolio

2.) A brief Cover Note or Loom Video addressing:

- The annual revenue scale of the largest Amazon Seller Central account you have personally managed.

- How you approach calculating and managing TACoS allocation across Sponsored Products, Sponsored

Brands, and Sponsored Display within a strict P&L framework.

- One specific example of a successful listing CRO experiment or promotional strategy you designed and

scaled on Amazon.



******COMPENSATION & BENEFITS******



• Base Salary: $3,500 to $5,000 USD per month, commensurate with experience and past scale

managed.

• Performance Bonus: Aggressive annual cash bonus tied directly to hitting clear, pre-agreed P&L and

growth KPIs.

• Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Distributed team.

• Impact & Ownership: High degree of executive autonomy over a substantial, mature $20M business

line with direct exposure to brand leadership.



WE CAN’T WAIT TO REVIEW YOUR APPLICATION AND DISCUSS HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOUR STRATEGIC VISION! 🏆🔥

title: Amazon DSP Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Amazon Demand-Side Platform (DSP) Specialist to manage, optimize, and scale Amazon DSP advertising campaigns across multiple client accounts, with additional experience in Amazon PPC advertising.



This is a client-facing role. The ideal candidate can present performance updates, explain advertising strategies, answer client questions, and provide clear, data-driven recommendations. The primary focus is DSP strategy, audience targeting, optimization, and performance analysis, while PPC knowledge supports integrated advertising plans. The specialist will work closely with the Amazon Advertising Lead.



Key Responsibilities

Amazon DSP Campaign Management (Primary Focus)

* Manage and optimize Amazon DSP campaigns across multiple client accounts.

* Develop full-funnel DSP strategies for awareness, acquisition, retargeting, and conversion.

* Build campaigns using first-party audiences, behavioral and contextual targeting, and custom audiences.

* Manage prospecting, remarketing, and competitor conquesting initiatives.

* Optimize budgets, bids, audience segments, frequency caps, placements, and creative performance.

* Analyze campaign, audience, placement, and ASIN-level results; track spend, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC, CPM, conversion rates, reach, frequency, and attributed sales.

* Use Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), where available, to support audience insights and measurement.

* Audit campaigns, identify wasted spend and incremental growth opportunities, and maintain effective budget pacing.

* Partner with creative teams to assess display, video, and other DSP assets



Amazon PPC Management (Secondary Focus)

* Support Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns.

* Apply working knowledge of keywords, product targeting, match types, bids, and placements.

* Review ACoS, ROAS, TACoS, CTR, CPC, and conversion performance.

* Coordinate DSP and PPC strategies to support overall sales and advertising efficiency.



Performance Analysis & Strategic Growth

* Identify trends, inefficiencies, growth opportunities, and potential root causes of performance changes.

* Consider organic sales, product rankings, pricing, inventory, and conversion rates when making recommendations.

* Develop and execute structured tests of audiences, creatives, placements, and campaign formats.

* Evaluate how DSP and PPC contribute together to broader Amazon advertising goals.



Client Communication & Reporting

* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights.

* Join client meetings, present results, and explain strategy and next steps clearly.

* Proactively communicate risks, opportunities, and data-backed recommendations.

* Document campaign optimizations, tests, findings, and decisions.



AI, Automation & Advertising Technology

* Use approved AI, analytics, automation, and advertising tools to improve efficiency and decision-making.

* Automate appropriate repetitive work without compromising accuracy.

* Stay current with Amazon DSP developments and advertising best practices.



Requirements

* 5+ years of hands-on Amazon advertising experience, including significant direct Amazon DSP campaign management.

* Strong expertise in DSP campaign setup, audience targeting, full-funnel strategy, optimization, reporting, and budget management.

* Working knowledge of Amazon PPC and Sponsored Ads campaign types.

* Understanding of attribution, campaign performance metrics, and profitability analysis.

* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

* Ability to manage multiple client accounts independently, diagnose problems, and meet deadlines.

* Excellent written and spoken English, including confidence presenting to U.S. clients.

* Comfortable with AI tools, automation, and advertising management software.



Preferred Experience

* Advanced DSP experience across multiple brands or agency accounts.

* Experience with Amazon Marketing Cloud, including audience creation and advanced measurement.

* Familiarity with Amazon Marketing Stream, third-party reporting tools, and advertising data integrations.

* Experience coordinating DSP and PPC strategies.

* Experience with Streaming TV, online video, and non-endemic advertising.



Performance KPIs

1. DSP Account Performance

* Meet or progress toward agreed ROAS, CPA, sales growth, reach, and other client goals.

* Identify declines early, improve efficiency, scale strong campaigns, and pace budgets appropriately.



Target: Managed accounts meet or make measurable progress toward agreed monthly objectives.



2. Campaign Optimization & Execution

* Complete scheduled optimizations and approved launches on time.

* Maintain accurate structures, targeting, naming, and documentation.



Target: Planned tasks completed on time with minimal execution errors.



3. Proactive Growth & Strategic Recommendations

* Identify new audiences, targeting approaches, and campaign expansion opportunities.

* Recommend structured tests and better coordination between DSP and PPC.



Target: At least two meaningful recommendations per account per month, where applicable.



4. Client Communication

* Come prepared with insights and next steps.

* Communicate issues proactively and respond accurately and professionally.



Target: On-time client deliverables without recurring communication issues.



5. Reporting & Analysis

* Deliver accurate weekly and monthly reports.

* Explain what changed, why it changed, and what should happen next.



Target: 100% of reports delivered by deadline with accurate, actionable insights.



6. AI & Tool Adoption

* Use approved tools and identify safe automation opportunities.

* Adapt to new workflows and demonstrate efficiency improvements.



Target: Consistent tool adoption and measurable workflow improvement.



What We're Looking For

We need someone who thinks beyond bid adjustments: an independent, strategic operator who can identify promising audiences, balance prospecting and retargeting, spot wasted spend, determine which campaigns merit investment, connect DSP with PPC, diagnose performance changes, and confidently explain recommendations to clients.



Success in This Role

Success means delivering against client objectives, maintaining strong execution standards, proactively identifying growth opportunities, and communicating clearly. The ideal candidate combines deep Amazon DSP expertise with practical PPC knowledge, strong analytical judgment, and independent multi-account management.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)
description:
Title:

AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)



Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: Technical QA Engineer (Laravel + Vue 2, post-deploy), EU property-tech + SaaS, remote
description:
Role

We ship small changes to our live platforms often. We want a technical QA engineer with a real developer background: you think like a user, but you can also read the code path, review merge requests, and tell us when the fix or the AI-suggested change should be different. After each release you check that landlords, renters, candidates and companies can still get from A to B to C. You are not the person who builds features full time, but you are close to a half-developer on our stack. Speed and quality, not one at the cost of the other.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We run several live rental and property platforms on one shared Laravel and Vue 2 codebase, plus a recruitment SaaS where candidates record video intakes for companies and agencies. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



Where you sit in our flow

We roll out to production often and we want to keep that pace. Developers deploy; you are not a gate before release and you do not own the deploy button. After each production rollout you test on
 the journeys that release touched, then the critical paths users depend on, on desktop and mobile, with test accounts and safe paths where we need them. You are the second check after go-live, not a blocker in front of it. When something fails for a real user, you report it fast with steps, expected versus actual, and enough detail that a developer can fix it the same day.



How we work

Our developers work with AI coding assistants and keep their changes small. You test the outcome in the browser and you sanity-check the change in GitLab: read the diff, spot risky patterns, and push back when generated code is sloppy or the wrong layer was touched. If something works on paper but feels wrong in the browser, you say so. You may use AI tools yourself, but the pass or fail comes from what you verified, not from what the model claimed.



What you will do

- After each production rollout, smoke-test the journeys that release touched, on desktop and on mobile

- Re-run the critical journeys per product: listing a property, booking a viewing, uploading documents, recording a video intake, reviewing candidates

- Explore beyond the release note when something looks fragile

- Check that a change on one platform did not break or leak into another platform on the same codebase

- Write clear bug reports: steps to reproduce, expected versus actual, severity, environment, browser and device, screenshot or short video

- Point developers to the file, layer, or request: Blade, Vue component, controller, query, or API response

- Give UX feedback in plain words, for example "a landlord would not know what to do here"

- Review merge requests and recent commits: what changed, what could regress, what should have been tested, what you would do differently

- Suggest concrete improvements to developers (and to AI-generated patches): safer query, clearer validation, better error handling, smaller scope



Requirements

- Strong technical background: you have worked as a developer or as QA embedded with developers, and you can read Laravel and Vue 2 code in a real codebase, not only tutorials

- Hands-on experience with Laravel web applications and Vue 2 front ends in production, or equivalent depth with a similar PHP plus SPA stack and a clear plan to work in our Vue 2 patterns

- Experience with multi-brand or multi-tenant products: one codebase, several sites or customers, and you know how a fix on one brand can break another

- Proven QA on live web products, with examples where your report or your review caught something others missed

- You think in user journeys and in the people behind them

- Clear written English, short and precise

- Solid GitLab or GitHub habits: branches, merge requests, reading diffs, commenting on specific lines

- Browser developer tools: console, network tab, status codes; you tie UI symptoms to backend responses

- Comfortable challenging AI-assisted development: you review output like a senior teammate, not like a checklist-only tester

- Reliable and self-directed: you find the next useful check without being told

- This role is QA and review first. We do not hire you primarily to ship features. Occasional tiny fixes are a bonus, not the job description.



Nice to have

- Accessibility basics: keyboard use, contrast, readable forms

- Ideas for light automated checks or regression notes, without making automation the whole role

- Docker-based local setup or Laravel Mix familiarity



Working hours: full time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 Amsterdam time. That is 15:00 to 23:00 in the Philippines in European summer, and 16:00 to 00:00 when Europe switches to winter time. Please state your timezone and the window you can reliably cover each workday.



Paid trial (before full engagement)

A paid trial week of about five working days, full time, at $3 per hour, tracked with TimeProof after signing. We give you test accounts, a short list of recent rollouts to verify the same way you would after go-live, and read-only visibility on merge requests where useful. You test like a real user on desktop and mobile, file bug reports and UX notes, and add technical review comments where you see risk in the change. You may use AI tools, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you report and every review comment.



The deal

Remote, full time, long term. Hours are tracked with TimeProof. Rate: $3 per hour to start, reviewed on quality and impact. This is a long-term role, not a one-off project.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Start your message with ABC.

2) One bug you found in production that others missed: how you reproduced it and how you reported it.

3) How you would test a release right after it goes live, without slowing every release down.

4) One example of UX feedback you gave that changed a flow.

5) A form submits and nothing happens. What do you send the developer?

6) One merge request or diff you reviewed: what you looked at in the code, what you worried about, and what you asked the developer to change.

7) Your timezone and the Amsterdam-time window you can cover.



Keep it short. Selected applicants do a short video intake on our platform before we talk.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work

- You only know QA in theory and cannot give real examples

- You have never read application code or merge request diffs in a real job

- You only write automated tests and do not think about the people using the product

- You want a pure development role with no testing responsibility

title: Customer Support Representative – DTC Comfort Footwear Brand (US Market)
description:
The Brand

We're a fast-growing direct-to-consumer footwear brand designing comfort shoes for women aged 50+. Our shoes look normal — not medical, not clunky — just well-made shoes that happen to feel incredible. We sell primarily through our Shopify store, driven by paid social traffic (Meta ads).



Our customers are loyal when treated right and vocal when they're not. That's where you come in.



The Role

You are the voice of this brand during the morning shift. Every
 you send either builds trust or breaks it. You'll be our second CS representative, handling inbound customer
s through Gorgias — returns, exchanges, shipping questions, damaged items, cancellations, and the occasional angry customer threatening a chargeback.



You'll work closely with Erwin, our CS Manager, who oversees the team via Slack. He's your first point of contact for questions, edge cases, and anything above your escalation threshold — you're never guessing alone.



This is not a "copy-paste templates and hope for the best" role. You'll use proven templates and a custom AI copilot as your foundation, but you'll need the judgment to know when to personalize, when to escalate to Erwin, and when to issue a refund immediately to protect the brand.



Your core responsibilities

Clear overnight backlog within the first 2 hours of every shift

Handle live tickets with a target response time under 30 minutes

Triage urgent cases (cancellations, address changes, chargeback threats) immediately

Follow our structured refund ladder — 30% ? 50% ? full refund — with precision, within your authorized limit

Escalate any refund/replacement decision above your threshold to Erwin in Slack before acting

Process refunds and replacements in Gorgias/Shopify and log them in our master sheet

De-escalate frustrated customers before they become disputes

Generate Trustpilot reviews from happy customers using our two-method system

Submit a daily end-of-shift report in Slack — every single day, no exceptions



What "A-Player" Looks Like in This Role

You don't just respond — you resolve. Our target is ?4 messages per ticket on average. That means your first reply needs to be so clear and complete that the customer doesn't need to write back three more times.



You protect the brand from chargebacks. If someone mentions "dispute," "bank," "fraud," or "lawyer" — you don't negotiate. You refund immediately if it's within your authorized limit, or you flag Erwin in Slack right away if it's above it. Either way, it gets handled fast. A refund is always cheaper than a chargeback + fees + a hit to our payment processor reputation.



You follow the system. We have templates, decision trees, escalation rules, and a refund ladder for a reason. You don't freelance on refund amounts. You don't promise faster shipping. You don't skip the photo proof step on damaged items. The system works — your job is to execute it with empathy and precision, and to loop in Erwin the moment something falls outside your lane.



You generate reviews without being pushy. Our best review moments come from size exchanges where the customer keeps the original pair for free. You'll learn to spot the "wow" moments and use them strategically.



You communicate proactively with your manager. Erwin handles all team communication through Slack. If you see a recurring issue with no template, you flag it to him. If you're unsure how to handle something, you ask — you don't guess. If Disputifier sends a fraud alert, you report it to Erwin and wait for instructions.



Escalation & Authority

You can independently process refunds/replacements following the refund ladder up to [$XX] per order.

Anything above that threshold, or anything unusual (fraud flags, legal threats, repeat offenders, policy exceptions) goes to Erwin in Slack before you act.

Erwin is your manager for day-to-day questions, scheduling, and performance feedback.

The KPIs You'll Be Measured On (Weekly)

First response time during shift: ?60 minutes

Backlog clearance: ?2 hours after shift start

Chargeback threat handling: flagged/resolved within 30 minutes

CSAT score: ?4.6 / 5.0

Messages per ticket: ?4.0 average

End-of-shift reports: 100% compliance

Policy accuracy: ?99% on refund amounts and escalation steps

Zero urgent tickets left unresolved at end of shift



Bonuses

On top of the base rate, you'll earn performance bonuses tied to:



Trustpilot review generation (target: 10+ published reviews/month, minimum 4 stars)

Maintaining CSAT above target

Chargeback rate staying below 0.7%

Consistent zero-backlog end-of-shift performance



Specific bonus structure will be discussed with top candidates.



Requirements

Fluent, professional English — our customers are 50+ Americans. Your writing must be warm, clear, and free of slang or grammar issues.

Gorgias experience preferred (Zendesk, Freshdesk, or similar helpdesk experience accepted)

Shopify experience — you need to be comfortable navigating orders, processing refunds, and duplicating orders for replacements

Reliable internet and a quiet workspace

Available Monday–Saturday, morning shift (US/Eastern business hours) — this is non-negotiable

Comfortable using AI tools — you'll use a custom GPT copilot for edge cases and need good judgment about when the AI output is right vs. when it needs editing

Comfortable working under a manager (Erwin) via Slack and following his direction on escalations



Nice to Have

Experience in DTC ecommerce customer support (especially footwear, apparel, or health/wellness)

Familiarity with chargeback prevention and dispute handling

Experience with Trustpilot or similar review platforms

Track record of high CSAT scores in previous roles



How to Apply

Send a short message (not a generic cover letter) answering these three questions:



Tell me about a time you de-escalated an angry customer who was threatening a chargeback or dispute. What did you do, and what was the outcome?

A customer writes in ALL CAPS saying they want a full refund because the shoes "look cheap." They haven't mentioned any defect — they just don't like the product. What do you do first? Walk me through your thinking step by step.

What's your current availability, and can you commit to a Monday–Saturday morning shift (US/Eastern hours)?



Applications without answers to these three questions will not be reviewed.

How to apply

title: GTA 6 Gameplay Recorder
description:

**Previous gameplay recording experience and a capture card are required. Preference will be given to applicants who already own GTA 6 or have it preordered.**



### What you’ll do



- Record GTA 6 gameplay, missions, activities, vehicles, and driving footage.

- **Notifications and trophy or achievement pop-ups turned off.**

title: Bail Operations Coordinator | Part-Time, Remote
description:
Bail Connect is a North Carolina bail bond agency looking for a dependable coordinator to run our day-to-day operations. Families often reach out during stressful situations. Your job is to keep calls, check-ins, payments, paperwork, and deadlines moving so families and agents know what happens next. We’ll train you on our systems and procedures.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



• Calls and follow-up. Answer routine calls, take accurate messages, verify factual information through approved sources, and connect callers with the licensed agent on duty. Log each inquiry and follow up until the agent documents the outcome.

• Client check-ins and weekly risk report. Call clients for scheduled check-ins and send approved upcoming court reminders. Record the results and report overdue check-ins, upcoming deadlines, payment discrepancies, missing documents, and expiring powers. Escalate missed court appearances and urgent concerns directly to the licensed agent.

• Payments and records. Track payment schedules, receipts, deposits, and agent remittances. Match payments to the correct bond and refer disputes or requests to change terms to the licensed agent.

• Bond paperwork and filings. Send agent-approved electronic packets, track signatures, and enter verified information in BailBooks. Assemble supporting court records, coordinate submission with the responsible agent, and track filing confirmations. Upload authorized administrative documents to the surety platform.

• Records research and skip-tracing support. Check approved sources for updated contact information at the licensed agent’s direction. Document the source and pass verified information to the agent for follow-up.

• Agent recruitment and coverage. Coordinate recruiting and onboarding, track documentation for review, and keep the licensed primary and backup roster current. Lead a short weekly team meeting and record each follow-up with an owner and due date.



Licensed agents assess cases, quote terms, make bond decisions, and handle regulated paperwork and compliance decisions.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Clear, professional spoken and written English. You communicate calmly with U.S. callers, confirm important details, and give accurate handoffs.

• Experience supporting a U.S.-based business or U.S. customers in administration, dispatch, customer service, recruiting, or operations.

• Reliable attendance, strong attention to detail, and a habit of following through without repeated reminders.

• Ability to learn new software quickly, manage competing deadlines, and handle confidential information with discretion.

• Reliable internet, a clear headset, and a quiet workspace.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



• Administrative days: Monday, 11 a.m.–3 p.m., and Tuesday and Wednesday, 2–6 p.m. U.S. Eastern time. The role starts with 12 scheduled hours per week at USD $3/hour during a 30-day pilot.

• Weekend on-call: Bail bonding is a 24/7 service, so the agency maintains coverage outside regular shifts. Your standby commitment is limited to agreed windows on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. During those windows, you’ll be the first contact for English calls and route bond inquiries to the licensed agent on duty. Go Answer handles Spanish calls, overflow, and calls outside your windows.

• Weekend pay: USD $25 per month for standby availability, plus USD $3/hour for recorded time spent answering calls, researching records, or completing follow-up work.



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your résumé, numbered answers to the three questions below, and one link to a 60–90 second English audio recording in a single application. Make sure the recording link opens without requesting access.



1. Availability: Can you work all three administrative shifts? List the windows you can reliably cover on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday in U.S. Eastern time and tell us your earliest start date.

2. Attention to detail: Describe a specific time you caught a payment, paperwork, or scheduling error. What did you do, and how did you confirm it was resolved?

3. Weekend judgment: You’re on call Saturday. A family is waiting for a callback, the licensed primary hasn’t responded, and an approved packet is missing a signature. What would you do first, whom would you contact, and what would you log?



Audio exercise: A caller says, “My brother was arrested in Mecklenburg County. I don’t know which jail he’s in. Can you tell me how much it’ll cost to get him out?” Respond as if you’re speaking directly to the caller. Then give the brief handoff you’d leave for the licensed agent, including what you confirmed and what still needs follow-up. Use fictional details.

title: ScreenFlow Video Editor (Mac user only)
description:
We record training videos for online courses. We need someone to tidy them up and add slides, in ScreenFlow, which only runs on MAC OS. It does not run on a PC.



1. This role pays $3 per hour.

2. Roughly 20 hrs/week.

3. You can only do this work if you have a MAC with Screenflow installed. 

***DO NOT apply if you don't have a MAC.



THE WORK



There are two parts to every video.



First, cut out mistakes. We record in long takes, and when the instructor fumbles a line he stops and says it again. You remove the bad version, keep the good one, and join the cut so it runs smoothly. The finished video should sound like he said it right the first time.



Second, add the slides. Each video comes with the recording, a set of slide images, and a timing file. The timing file gives you the exact sentence where each slide starts and the exact sentence where it ends. There is no guesswork and no decisions for you to make. You place the slides, size my webcam down to a small picture in picture in the corner, and export.



The first job is around 60 videos, sent in batches. After that we carry on producing new videos every month, so there is a steady flow of work from here on. This is a long-term role rather than a one-off project.



REQUIREMENTS: **SCREENFLOW ONLY**.



Not Premiere, not Final Cut, not DaVinci, not CapCut. 



We work in ScreenFlow and need the project files back in Screenflow so we can edit them later. Work done in any other software is no use to us.



YOU MUST USE A MAC. Because ScreenFlow only runs on macOS.

It doesn't run on PC.



English good enough to follow a timing file and to hear where the instructor has repeated a line.

If a video comes back with a mistake, you fix it at no extra charge. We do not pay twice for the same work.



TO APPLY



Start your message with the word ScreenFlow. Then tell us:



How long you have used ScreenFlow

That you accept $3 per hour

A link to something you have edited



Messages that do not start with ScreenFlow will not be read.

title: Senior Local SEO Strategist / Website Content Architecture
description:
Hiring: Senior Local SEO Strategist / Website Experience & Content Architecture



Company: Rank & Rent Factory

Work Arrangement: Remote - Philippines-based professionals welcome

Engagement: Freelance / contract; ongoing part-time and project-based opportunities

Compensation: Negotiable based on demonstrated expertise, scope, and experience. Please provide your expected rate and currency.



About the Opportunity

Rank & Rent Factory develops local lead generation websites for U.S. home-service markets, including roofing, concrete, tree services, and other contractor industries.



We're seeking an experienced Senior Local SEO Strategist who combines deep organic local SEO knowledge, website content architecture expertise, and practical customer experience (UX) and conversion judgment.



Your main responsibility is to determine what a website should contain, how its pages and information should be organized, and how those decisions can attract relevant visitors, help customers make informed decisions, and generate qualified inquiries.



You'll collaborate with our Web Asset Production Lead to develop practical website recommendations and implementation requirements. Production changes will be coordinated through the existing team.



This is primarily a strategic role, not a WordPress development, backlink outreach, graphic design, or bulk content-writing position.



Key Responsibilities

Local Organic SEO and Market Research

- Analyze service demand, customer search intent, local competitors, and geographic opportunities.

- Identify commercially relevant keywords, markets, service-page opportunities, and location targets.

- Develop evidence-based strategies for new websites and improvements to existing assets.

- Distinguish organic website SEO performance from Google Maps, Business Profile, and paid advertising results.



Website Content and Information Architecture

- Plan homepage, service-page, location-page, and supporting-content relationships.

- Develop keyword-to-page mappings, site hierarchy, internal linking, and meaningful page differentiation.

- Prepare actionable SEO content briefs covering page purpose, customer questions, required information, and credibility.

- Avoid unnecessary, repetitive, or thin pages created solely to target keyword variations.



Customer Experience (UX) and Conversion

- Consider the customer journey from search result to landing page, clear information, confident decision, and qualified inquiry.

- Evaluate information hierarchy, navigation, readability, mobile usability, visual presentation, and contact pathways.

- Recommend improvements that help customers understand services, assess options, establish trust, and take appropriate action.

- Provide annotated page outlines, simple wireframes, or similar guidance that Production can implement.



Content Quality, Implementation, and Improvement

- Define expectations for accurate, useful, service-specific website content.

- Recommend opportunities to incorporate authentic project evidence, relevant photography, contractor knowledge, and verifiable trust signals.

- Flag missing information and unsupported business claims rather than inventing details.

- Collaborate with Production on implementation, review checkpoints, and SEO/UX tradeoffs.

- Establish clear priorities, assumptions, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.

- Evaluate meaningful outcomes such as organic visibility, relevant traffic, qualified inquiries, customer usability, and production effort.

- Contribute evidence-based improvements to RNRF's evolving Ideal Website Architecture Standards (IWAS).



IWAS is a working framework, not a fixed template. We welcome specialists who can constructively challenge existing approaches and recommend practical improvements supported by evidence.



Required Qualifications

- Proven professional experience in organic local SEO, preferably for U.S. home-service businesses or local lead generation websites.

- Strong keyword research, SERP analysis, geographic targeting, on-page SEO, and website architecture skills.

- Demonstrated ability to develop practical site structures, keyword-to-page mappings, content briefs, and implementation requirements.

- Strong understanding of search intent, customer decision-making, UX, information hierarchy, and conversion.

- Familiarity with Google Search Console and professional SEO research tools.

- Ability to communicate strategic reasoning clearly and distinguish observed results from assumptions or untested hypotheses.

- Independent judgment, sound research skills, and constructive collaboration with production teams.

- Experience with rank-and-rent websites, technical SEO, WordPress, conversion research, or repeatable website production systems is valuable but not mandatory.

- We prioritize deep SEO expertise, practical architectural judgment, and customer-focused recommendations. Expert graphic design and coding skills are not required.



Initial Engagement and Opportunities

Our primary goal is to work with one senior strategist for ongoing part-time collaboration.



An initial assignment may focus on one real website or market, with agreed deliverables such as a prioritized diagnosis, proposed sitemap, search-intent mapping, and a detailed priority-page brief incorporating UX and conversion recommendations.



We may also consider additional specialists for independent architecture reviews, alternative proposals, or defined projects when their expertise adds clear value.



There is no predetermined number of engagements. Opportunities depend on demonstrated capability, business needs, availability, implementation capacity, and approved budgets.



How to Apply

Interested applicants should complete the application form below. All application requirements and instructions are provided in the form.



Application Form:


 



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid, time-boxed practical assessment using a defined brief and consistent evaluation criteria.



We look forward to working with specialists who can help us build more useful, credible, and effective local service websites.

title: Video Editor (AI Native)
description:
The Role



We are searching for a number of freelance video editors who can produce social video ads end to end: generating footage and assets with AI video platforms (Higgsfield, Kling, Veo and similar), and editing them into finished vertical ads for TikTok and Instagram, complete with captions, on-screen text, sound effects and music. You will work from an approved script, an editor brief and a set of references on every job. Fluency with AI video generation and native-level English are central to the role, along with creative judgement. The brief sets the direction, and you bring the ideas, taste and craft that make the ad worth watching.



*** Outstanding editors can earn $500 - $1000 USD+ a week!



About Us



We are a UK-based production agency creating social video ads for consumer brands, including well-known names in beauty, wellness, sport and consumer goods.



Main Responsibilities



Editing paid social video ads from our scripts and editor briefs.

Generating A-roll and B-roll using AI video platforms, following our prompts and art direction.

Adding native-style captions, on-screen text, sound design and music to brief.

Understanding the technicals of production and delivering based on video specifications.

Following briefs exactly and delivering on time, every time.

Revising edits based on feedback, quickly and without drama.



Essential Requirements



You must have skills in all of the following. If you do not have these skills, you will not be considered.



Native-level English. This is critical. You understand a brief first time, and your on-screen text is flawless. Bonus points if you can understand different English accents (American, English, Australian etc).

AI literacy. This is critical. You use AI video tools as a core part of your daily workflow, including Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2, Kling 3.0, Gemini Omni, ElevenLabs, Suno and Seedance 2.5. You understand image-to-video, keyframes and prompting fundamentals.

Social-native editing. You understand paid social on TikTok and Instagram: pacing, hooks, native captions, and what makes an ad feel at home in the feed.

Editing craft. Strong, fast editing skills and the discipline to work to deadlines.

Creativity. You bring ideas and taste to every edit, not just execution.

Speedy communication. You are very communicative: fast replies during working hours, active on Slack and WhatsApp every day, with at least 2 hours of overlap with the UK morning (approximately 4:00pm to 6:00pm Philippine Time).

Reliability. You follow briefs, work fast, and deliver on time without being chased.



Desirable



Experience editing paid social ads for e-commerce or DTC brands.

An understanding of paid advertising concepts.

Problem solving skills.



What We Offer



Per-video pay with no ceiling: You are paid per approved video, not per hour. The more quality work you deliver, the more you earn, and there is no cap. Fast turnarounds on approved work earn bonuses on top. Strong performers can receive several videos per week and priority on new briefs, with potential to earn $1000+ per week.

Well-known brands: Your ads will run on some globally recognised brand channels.

Genuinely creative work: This is a truly creative role where you will use the best AI video models in the industry, at the frontier of where advertising is going. If you love this technology and want to work in a frontier sector, this is a role where you get paid to be great at it.

Opportunity to grow: We are scaling, and the editors who prove themselves get more volume, higher-value productions and bigger roles, responsibility and earning potential as we expand.

Assistance along the way: Scripts, briefs, reference videos, art direction and structured feedback are all supplied on every job. You focus on the edit.

Record a 30-second video talking through your workflow and experience with AI platforms.

Provide at least two or three links to past work, including paid social ads you have produced. Links must open without login or access requirements.

title: Senior SEO Content Writer / Editor
description:
Hiring: Senior SEO Content Writer / Editor



Company: Rank & Rent Factory

Work Arrangement: Remote - Philippines-based professionals welcome

Engagement: Freelance / contract; ongoing part-time and project-based opportunities

Compensation: Negotiable based on demonstrated expertise, scope, and experience. Please provide your expected rate and currency.



About the Opportunity

Rank & Rent Factory develops local lead generation websites for U.S. home-service markets, including roofing, concrete, tree services, and other contractor industries.



We're looking for experienced professionals who can create or independently review original, accurate, SEO-focused website content that helps potential customers understand services, build trust, and make informed decisions.



Our primary opportunity is a Senior SEO Content Writer / Editor responsible for independent research, original writing, substantive self-editing, and delivering high-quality commercial website content.



We may also engage qualified professionals for independent editorial review, specialist writing, backup assignments, and defined content-improvement projects.



Applicants may apply for SEO Content Writing, Independent SEO Content Editing / Review, or both. Writing and independent reviewing capabilities will be evaluated separately.



Our focus is homepages, service pages, location pages, and supporting customer information, not primarily blog writing or mass-produced AI content.



Role 1 - Senior SEO Content Writer

Research and Original Content Creation

- Independently research unfamiliar home-service industries, technical subjects, customer concerns, and relevant terminology using credible sources.

- Develop original, accurate, and useful commercial website content based on approved SEO briefs.

- Explain services clearly in language appropriate for U.S. homeowners and potential customers.

- Write engaging headlines, helpful introductions, substantive service explanations, FAQs, and appropriate calls to action.

- Follow search intent and SEO requirements while integrating relevant keywords naturally and avoiding repetitive, generic content.



Customer Experience (UX) and Conversion

- Organize information for clarity, logical flow, readability, and easy scanning.

- Anticipate customer questions, concerns, and decision-making needs.

- Help visitors understand services, compare relevant options, recognize credible information, and confidently take the next step.

- Recommend useful supporting elements such as comparisons, tables, captions, visuals, or project evidence when appropriate.

- Support qualified inquiries through clear, accurate, customer-focused messaging rather than exaggerated claims.



Accuracy, Substantive Self-Editing, and Delivery

- Fact-check important information, document reliable sources, and identify unresolved questions.

- Distinguish general industry information from business-specific claims requiring authorized confirmation.

- Substantively self-edit for accuracy, originality, clarity, usefulness, structure, SEO alignment, and customer experience.

- Deliver clean, production-ready copy with relevant source notes, metadata or internal-link suggestions where requested, and clearly flagged information gaps.

- Respond constructively to independent editorial feedback and resolve required corrections.



Role 2 - Independent SEO Content Editor / Reviewer

We also welcome experienced professionals who can independently assess SEO website content written by others.



This role requires strong SEO content knowledge, research ability, customer experience judgment, and substantive editorial skills, not proofreading alone.



Responsibilities include:

- Review website content against approved SEO briefs, search intent, and customer needs.

- Evaluate keyword integration, page structure, headings, information hierarchy, readability, and content usefulness.

- Identify unanswered customer questions, confusing explanations, weak messaging, unnecessary repetition, and conversion barriers.

- Verify important factual claims and flag inaccuracies, unsupported statements, or misleading business information.

- Evaluate whether content establishes credibility, supports customer decisions, and provides an appropriate next step.

- Provide clear, evidence-based editorial findings and recommended corrections.

- Distinguish required corrections from useful improvements and personal stylistic preferences.

- Identify issues requiring additional research, SEO strategist input, or authorized subject-matter verification.

- Determine whether content meets editorial requirements, needs further corrections, or should be held pending verification.

- Independent editorial review is separate from content writing.



Requirements for Both Opportunities

- Strong understanding of SEO-focused commercial website content, including local SEO, search intent, content hierarchy, and natural keyword integration.

- Professional experience with website content writing or substantive editing, preferably for U.S. home-service businesses or local lead generation websites.

- Excellent written English, clarity, organization, and customer-focused communication.

- Strong independent research, fact-checking, and critical-thinking skills.

- Ability to understand unfamiliar services and explain or evaluate technical information accurately.

- Practical understanding of content-level UX, customer decision-making, trust, readability, and conversion.

- Ability to recognize weak, generic, inaccurate, misleading, or unhelpful content.

- Strong professional judgment, reliability, and constructive collaboration.

- Writing applicants must demonstrate original research-based writing and substantive self-editing.

- Editorial applicants must demonstrate independent content evaluation, factual verification, and meaningful editorial improvements.

- Experience with rank-and-rent websites, technical service writing, conversion copy, or project case studies is valuable but not mandatory.



Working With Our Team

Our SEO / Website Experience Strategist leads page strategy, search intent, architecture, and strategic requirements.



The SEO Content Writer researches, writes, and self-edits content while contributing professional recommendations and raising concerns about weak briefs or missing information.



An Independent SEO Content Reviewer evaluates content against approved requirements before publication.



Our Web Asset Production Lead coordinates assignments, handoffs, implementation, and publication requirements.



Significant changes to approved content strategy are discussed rather than introduced without agreement.



Writing and editorial contributors may also help improve RNRF's evolving Ideal Website Architecture Standards (IWAS) through practical lessons about content quality, credibility, customer experience, and editorial consistency.



Engagement Opportunities

We are primarily seeking one senior content creator for ongoing part-time collaboration.



Additional project-based opportunities may include:

- Independent SEO content editing and editorial quality review.

- Specialist or backup content writing.

- Defined content improvement and research assignments.

- Approved content or editorial experiments where appropriate.



There is no predetermined number of engagements. Work depends on demonstrated capability, production needs, availability, and approved budgets.



How to Apply

Interested applicants should complete the application form below. All application requirements and instructions are provided in the form.



Application Form:


 



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid, time-boxed practical assessment tailored to the work under consideration.



We look forward to working with professionals who can help us produce useful, accurate, persuasive, and trustworthy websites.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property/SaaS-tech, remote)
description:
Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

Job Scope:

You should have: 

• Proven experience in SEO, preferably for e-commerce websites, with measurable results.

• Strong knowledge of technical SEO, keyword research, content optimisation, and AEO.

• Hands-on experience with SEO analytics and AI-powered tools, with the ability to independently implement and track improvements.

• Shopify or WordPress experience (a plus)

• Clear written English and data-led reporting



You should be comfortable with:

• Hands-on SEO using GA4 and Google Search Console

• AI search optimisation, content structuring, and schema (JSON-LD).y

Note:

• Full-time basis – 40 hrs/week

• Monday to Friday

IMPORTANT: When applying, please provide:

- Why you are leaving your last job or what you were doing just before this application

- Examples of SEO or AEO results you have achieved (for example before-and-after rankings, traffic or AI citations, with GA4 or Search Console screenshots if possible). 



Applications without the above points will be less considered.

- Video introduction here:

- Here are examples of my work...



The more information you provide in your initial application, the better.





Best regards,

Loo Yi

title: Senior Finance Manager / Controller
description:
Full time, 40 hours a week, spread across 7 days. Remote, based in the Philippines. Reports to the CEO. Flexible daily working hours, with a consistent reporting deadline of 1:00 PM PHT: 



We are a 24/7 business. That is why the week is 7 days and not 5. The hours are normal, the rhythm is not. 



We are a two entity, two market, inventory heavy DTC beauty business running on Shopify and Amazon with China direct and 3PL fulfilment. Revenue is not our problem. Visibility is.



We need a qualified accountant who turns a messy, cross border operation into a small set of numbers we can look at every single day and trust. Not a month end role. Not a board deck role. A daily discipline role.



The rhythm is the point: a report lands every morning, seven days a week, including weekends and holidays. We spend money on ads every day, so we need to see profit and cash every day. Weekends are when problems hide.



The Philippines time zone is a deliberate advantage here. You work your morning, the previous European day has just closed, and your pack is in Slack before Amsterdam opens.



You will work alongside our existing external accounting partners (a US accounting firm, Dutch bookkeepers and a cross border accountant) rather than replacing them. They handle statutory and compliance. You own management reporting.



The daily rhythm

Every day, 7 days a week, delivered by 13:00 PHT (around 07:00 CET).



• Cash position across all bank accounts and both entities

• Yesterday’s revenue, gross profit and ad spend by market and channel

• Blended MER and contribution margin after ad spend

• Refunds, chargebacks and payment provider reserve movements

• Any red flag, called out in one line at the top

Weekend versions can be a lighter, largely templated snapshot, but they land.



Every Monday:

• Full management P&L for the prior week

• Contribution margin by SKU, channel and market

• Inventory position and stock cover in weeks

• Rolling 13 week cash flow forecast, updated

• KPI pack for the founding team



Every month:

• Consolidated cross border P&L (NL and US) and balance sheet review

• Variance against plan, with commentary on the why

• Reconciliation sign off across Shopify, Amazon, payment providers, 3PL and the ledger



What You’ll Own Beyond the Reporting

• Cash forecasting: the rolling 13 week forecast, including inventory and purchase order cash planning against production lead times

• Unit economics: true landed COGS per SKU (freight, duty, fulfilment), and contribution margin by SKU, channel, market and cohort

• Channel P&Ls: Shopify DACH, Shopify US, Amazon US, comparable and reconciled

• Payment risk monitoring: reserves, rolling reserves and chargeback exposure

• FX exposure across EUR, USD and PHP

• Invoice verification: supplier and 3PL invoices checked against contracted terms

• Automation: templates, defined metrics, connected data sources. If the daily pack takes two hours by month three, something is wrong



What We’re Looking For

• Philippine CPA, or an equivalent qualification with a strong practical track record

• 4+ years in accounting or finance, including hands on management reporting

• Ecommerce or inventory based business experience

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets. You have built cash flow models yourself

• Comfortable reconciling data from Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, payment gateways and 3PL reports

• Multi currency and multi entity experience

• Reliable to a fault. A pack that lands 6 days out of 7 is worth a fraction of one that lands 7

• Willing to work a 7 day rhythm with light weekend days, and to cover Philippine public holidays 

• Excellent written English and the confidence to tell a CEO a number he will not like



Strong Plus

• Beauty, cosmetics or CPG experience

• Experience reporting for a Western or European company from the Philippines

• BI or automation skills (Looker Studio, Power BI, SQL, Zapier or similar)

• Familiarity with NL and US cross border reporting

• Xero, QuickBooks or a comparable cloud ledger



First 90 Days Looks Like Success If

1. The daily pack has landed every day for 30 consecutive days and leadership trusts it

2. A 13 week rolling cash forecast is live, updated weekly, and reliable enough to make decisions on

3. True landed COGS and contribution margin are known per SKU and per channel

4. The daily pack takes under 45 minutes to produce because the rest is automated



What We Offer

• Fully remote, permanently

• Direct access to the CEO

• Genuine ownership of the finance function as it grows

• HMO health coverage and 13th month pay

• Paid monthly via Wise



What to Include in Your Application

• Your CPA registration number, or the equivalent qualification with the body that issued it

• One management report you built yourself, redacted as needed, so we can see the format and the metrics you chose

• The names of the systems you have reconciled across, and for which business

• Confirmation in writing that you are available on a 7 day rhythm

title: Appointment Setter - Australian Health Clinics (Warm Leads, No Cold Calling)
description:
We work with health clinics in Australia - physiotherapy, chiropractic and osteopathy.



People see our clients' ads on Facebook and Instagram and fill in a short form asking about an appointment. Your job is to call that person within 5 minutes and book them into the clinic's calendar.



These are warm leads. Everyone you call has already asked to be contacted. This is not cold calling.



FULL JOB DETAILS

Read the complete description here before applying:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MUPwzzCC6DOuTk8iwiOu31tyD8iisZ3W2oW1UTJI6x0/view



It covers the hours, pay, what we expect, and the rules you must follow. Please read it properly - a lot of your questions are answered there.



HOURS

Monday to Friday, 7:00am to 7:00pm Manila time (9:00am to 9:00pm Sydney time). From October to April it becomes 6:00am to 6:00pm Manila time.



This is NOT 12 hours of non-stop calling. You need to be reachable across that window so any new lead gets called within 5 minutes. There are quiet stretches, and once your follow-up calls are done your time is your own.



PAY

AUD $750 per month base, plus AUD $5 for every appointment you book and AUD $3 more when that person shows up. Paid monthly through Wise. Independent contractor. Reviewed after 60 days, and it can go up as we add more clinics.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS JOB

Calling every new lead within 5 minutes. We can teach you everything else. If a lead comes in at 2:14pm, we want your first call logged by 2:19pm. Someone great on the phone but slow to call new leads is not a fit. Someone only okay on the phone who never misses the 5-minute window will do well here.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call every new lead within 5 minutes. No answer: call again, leave a vocemail, send a text.

- Work the follow-up schedule - twice daily in week one, once daily to day 30, then weekly.

- Ask a few short questions, then book them into the clinic's calendar.

- Log every call, text and result in our CRM (GoHighLevel - we train you on it).

- Hand over once they are booked. The clinic's front desk looks after them from there.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Clear, easy-to-understand spoken English and a friendly phone manner.

- Available across the full window, Monday to Friday.

- Phone experience: appointment setting, inside sales or customer service.

- Reliable internet with a backup connection, plus backup power.

- A good headset and a quiet place to work.

- Someone who takes coaching well. We review recorded calls together and give direct feedback.



PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

Our clients are registered health professionals, and Australia has strict rules about what can be said about healthcare. You must never give medical advice, never tell someone what is wrong with them or what is causing it, and never promise they will get better. Anything medical goes to the practitioner. You will follow the script we give you. If that sounds like a problem, this is not the right job for you, and that is completely fine.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply only through this form:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfBq0Ion1HPKeytCaaNVM4cHS37ZobTx-zzcFYfXrBgIT6tgA/viewform



It includes a voice recording under 90 seconds. We do not review applications without it.



Please do not reply here with your CV - use the form.

title: Appointment Setter WITH BONUSES
description:
Virtual Assistant — Outbound Caller & Appointment Setter

Remote (Philippines) | Full-Time | Life Insurance



About the Role:

8AM-3PM CT or 3PM-9PM CT



We are a fast-growing life insurance agency based in Illinois looking for a driven, fluent English-speaking VA to join our team. Your job is straightforward — call people who already have life insurance, introduce them to a better option, and either book them for a review call with our agent or transfer them live.



Every person you dial already has an existing life insurance policy. You are not selling from scratch. You are having a simple conversation: their current policy costs more and offers less — we can switch them to a better carrier with lower premiums and added benefits. Your job is to get them on the phone with our agent so they can see that for themselves.

This is a warm outbound role. No cold prospecting. No selling. Just real conversations that lead to appointments and transfers.



Schedule

8:00 AM – 3:00 PM CST (Central Standard Time) OR 3:00PM - 9:00PM CST (Central Standard Time), Monday through Friday. We are flexible with hours as long as you hit KPI's. You must be logged in and actively dialing during the hours. CST is night shift Philippines time — please confirm you can fully commit to this schedule before applying. Every morning starts with a team training session before dialing begins.



What You'll Do 



- Call warm leads using our GoHighLevel power dialer — these people already have life insurance and are open to reviewing their options

- Follow our proven script to introduce the consolidation opportunity and book a review appointment or transfer live

- Warm transfer hot leads directly to our agent when they are ready to talk immediately

- Log every call with accurate notes and dispositions in GoHighLevel immediately after every call

- Drop pre-recorded voi
s on no-answers with one click

- Send confirmation texts to booked leads directly from GoHighLevel

- Hit a minimum of 150 dials per day

- Attend the daily morning training session — this is mandatory, not optional

- Submit your end-of-day report every day by 5PM CST: dials, contacts, appointments booked, live transfers sent





Systems We Use



- GoHighLevel (GHL) — CRM, power dialer, calendar, and messaging. You will live in this system all day

- WhatsApp — team communication, morning check-ins, and daily accountability

- Google Sheets — end-of-day report tracking



Full training provided on all systems before your first live dial day.



Requirements



- Fluent, neutral-accent English — non-negotiable. You will speak to Americans all day every day

- Prior outbound calling experience — insurance, appointment setting, BPO, or call center background on US campaigns required

- Experience in insurance specifically is a strong advantage — life insurance, health insurance, final expense, or any related product

- Minimum 25 Mbps internet, wired connection strongly preferred

- Own laptop or desktop — no tablets, no Chromebooks

- Quiet, dedicated home office — zero background noise

- Fully available and committed to CST business hours including Saturdays

- Coachable, consistent, and resilient — you will hear no regularly and it cannot affect your energy





Compensation



- Base: $100 a week + $25 per close. (YOU WILL AVERAGE 7 CLOSES A WEEK FROM US) 

- Performance bonus: $25 per tracked sale — every time a lead you booked or transferred results in a closed policy, you earn $25. All sales have to be tracked in GoHighLevel so everything is transparent.

- Weekly streak bonus: $50 extra if you hit 5+ tracked sales in a single week

- Monthly bonuses 

- Paid bi-weekly

- 30-day performance review — strong performers receive a base pay increase and first access to expanded hours and responsibilities

**Full-Time | Remote | $4-$6 USD/Hour | Long-Term Career Opportunity**
